{{Breadcrumb Auto|parent=Game Mechanics}} '''Effects''' are certain conditions and modifiers that impact gameplay in various ways. These effects are viewable on the [[Galactic War|Galactic Map]]. The number of Effects and type vary by [[Biome]], [[Factions|Faction]], and [[Difficulty]]. ==Weapons Experimentation/Arsenal Augmentation== Occasionally, [[Federation of Super Earth|Super Earth]] High Command makes certain [[Stratagems]] available for [[Helldiver]]s to deploy with as an additional mission standard-issue stratagem. These augmentations are purely additive and do not take up a slot on a Helldiver's Stratagem loadout. == Democracy Space Station == The [[Democracy Space Station]] can provide a Helldiver-funded "Tactical Action" in addition to the Liberation Campaign boosting "Operational Support" to whichever planet is being orbited.
{{DSS Action|Eagle Storm}} {{DSS Action|Orbital Blockade}} {{DSS Action|Heavy Ordnance Distribution}}
{{DSS Action|Effects}}
==Environmental Conditions== Environmental conditions refer to geophysical events that influence a [[Planets and Sectors|Planet's]] environment, experienced throughout [[missions]]. * {{Environmental Conditions|Acid Storms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Blizzards}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Extreme Cold}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Fire Tornados}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Intense Heat}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Ion Storms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Meteor Storms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Rainstorms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Sandstorms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Thick Fog}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Tremors}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Volcanic Activity}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Heavy Gloom Shroud}} * '''Moderate Gloom Blanket:''' The Gloom covers this planet completely, obstructing a variety of logistical operations. Extraction times are increased by 30 seconds and Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 20%. * '''Light Gloom Cover:''' Gloom particles interfere with landing Pelicans, increasing extraction times by 20 seconds. * '''[[Hive World|Gloom Source]]:''' This planet continually produces a thick atmospheric Gloom cover, rendering logistical support extremely challenging. Total Reinforcements are reduced by 20%, Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 30%, and Ammo from pickups is reduced by 50%. ===Operational Effects=== Sometimes, during certain events or Major Orders, some, if not all planets may gain an extra effect/modifier, available on all difficulties. * '''Orbital Fluctuations:''' All Orbital Stratagems have an increased cooldown. ''(not to be confused with the Operation Modifier with the same name, this effect only affects [[Stratagems|Orbital Stratagems]])'' * '''Medical Supply Strain:''' Number of stims each Helldiver deploys with decreased by 1. * '''Pilot Shortage:''' Extraction takes 30 additional seconds. * '''Slower Eagle Rearm:''' Eagle Rearm time is 25% slower. ==Operation Modifiers== Operation Modifiers are added obstacles that Helldivers must handle on the battlefield. A single Modifier will appear on {{Difficulty|5}}, increasing to two at {{Difficulty|8}}. Operation Modifiers do not appear on planets undergoing a [[Second Galactic War Mechanics#Defense Campaigns|Defense Campaign.]] ===General=== *[[Complex Stratagem Plotting]] – Stratagem Call-in time increased by 50%. *[[Orbital Fluctuations]] – Stratagem cooldown increased by 25%. *[[Poor Intel]] – Objective locations are hidden. *[[Civilians and SEAF in Area]] - [[SEAF Soldier]] squads and [[Civilian|Civilians]] are both on the battlefield. (Event modifier only present in [[Biomes#City Biomes|Metropolis Biomes]]) ===Faction-Specific=== {{Terminid|text}} *[[Atmospheric Spores]] – Map obscured by Bug Spores. *[[Roving Shriekers]] - Flying Shrieker swarms traverse the battlefield. {{Automaton|text}} *[[Gunship Patrols]] - Flying Gunships patrol the battlefield. {{Illuminate|text}} *[[Leviathan Blockade]] - Flying Leviathan warships patrol the battlefield. ===Removed=== *[[AA Defenses]] – Stratagem slots reduced by 1. *[[Atmospheric Interference]] – Orbital Stratagems Scatter Increased. *[[Electronic Countermeasures]] – Stratagem Codes Scrambled. == Combatant Forces == Some planets or cities will have modifiers that affect the types of units that spawn, whether it be friendly units or enemy ones, with them either increasing the frequency of specific units, replacing certain units with unique variants, or having entirely unique units. '''{{Terminid|text}}''' * Subfactions: ** [[Predator Strain]] - Unique cunning variants of [[Predator Hunter|Hunters]] and [[Predator Stalker|Stalkers]] will appear. ** [[Rupture Strain]] - Unique burrowing variants of [[Rupture Warrior|Warriors]], [[Rupture Spewer|Spewers]] and [[Rupture Charger|Chargers]] will appear. ** [[Spore Burst Strain]] - Unique explosive variants of [[Spore Burst Scavenger|Scavengers]], [[Spore Burst Hunter|Hunter]]s and [[Spore Burst Warrior|Warriors]] will appear. ** [[Dragonroach|Dragonroaches]] - [[Bile Titan|Bile Titans]] will be replaced with a unique flying enemy; the [[Dragonroach|Dragonroach.]] ** [[Hive Lord|Hive Lords]] - The colossal worm-like [[Hive Lord]] will appear. (Requires {{Difficulty|7}} or above.) '''{{Automaton|text}}''' * Subfactions: ** [[Jet Brigade]] - Unique [[Assault Raider]] units will appear alongside jetpack-equipped variants of [[Jet Brigade Trooper|Troopers]], [[Jet Brigade MG Raider|MG Raiders]], [[Jet Brigade Commissar|Commissars]], [[Jet Brigade Devastator|Devastators]], [[Jet Brigade Hulk Scorcher|Hulk Scorchers]] and [[Jet Brigade Hulk Bruiser|Hulk Bruisers]]. ** [[Incineration Corps]] - Unique [[Conflagration Devastator]] and [[Hulk Firebomber]] units will appear alongside incendiary-wielding variants of [[Pyro Trooper|Troopers]], [[Incendiary Rocket Raider|Rocket Raiders]] and [[Incendiary MG Devastator|Heavy Devastators]]. ** [[Cyborg Legion|Cyborgs]] - Unique cyborg [[Agitator]], [[Radical]] and [[Vox Engine]] units will appear. * Enemy Divisions: ** Hulk Surge - [[Hulk|Hulk units]] will spawn with increased frequency. ** Heavy Armor Surge - [[Tank|Tanks]] and [[Strider|Striders]] will spawn with increased frequency. ** Devastator Surge - [[Devastator]] units will spawn with increased frequency. '''{{Illuminate|text}}''' * Subfaction: ** [[Appropriators]] - Unique [[Obtruder]], [[Veracitor]], and [[Gatekeeper]] units will appear. ** [[Vote Snatchers]] - Unique [[Wretch]] and [[Crusher]] units will appear * Enemy Division: ** [[Mindless Masses]] - [[Voteless]] and [[Fleshmob]] units will spawn with increased frequency. ** [[Invasion Fleet]] - [[Voteless]], [[Overseer]], [[Crescent Overseer]], [[Elevated Overseer]], [[Fleshmob]], [[Watcher]], [[Harvester]] and [[Stingray]] units will spawn with increased frequency. '''{{Super Earth|text= Federation of Super Earth}} *Division: ** [[Heavy SEAF Presence]] - [[SEAF Soldier]]s will be deployed into mission areas via [[Pelican Shuttle|Pelican Shuttles]]. == Other Effects == === Armor Passives === [[Armor Passives]] are unique, player-specific abilities or enhancements that are tied to their corresponding body armors. Depending on the perk, different stat(s) will be affected, altering the way Helldivers can operate in the mission. === Boosters === Each Helldiver has the option to equip a [[Boosters|booster]] before deployment, which applies buff to the entire squad. Depending on the booster, it can alter a Helldiver's stats, certain pieces of equipment, or mission mechanics. === Status Effects === [[Status Effects]] are various status effects that can alter the Helldiver or their Enemies. These range to effects from the burning or gas effects of specific weaponry, to effects from stratagems, enemies, or environmental conditions. === Physical Conditions === [[Physical Conditions]] refer to adverse effects that a Helldiver may experience on the battlefield. These conditions can range from minor debuffs to being fatal if left untreated. Depending on the condition, it can be self-inflicted, caused by the environment, or applied by an enemy attack. {{Quote|A strain of Terminids with toxin-secreting glands is lurking on this planet. Prepare to face enemies that strike with incapacitating venom.|Galactic War Table Description}}

The {{Noxious Strain|text}} is a [[Terminids|Terminid]] sub-faction consisting of "noxious" Terminids. These enemies will bite Helldivers, afflicting them with [[Status Effects#Poison|poison]], and slow them down with webs.

== Enemies ==
<dpl>
  category=Noxious Strain Terminids
  notcategory=Subfactions
  uses=Template:Infobox Enemy
  mode=userformat
  ordermethod=sortkey
  format=<gallery>,File:%PAGE% Enemy Icon.png|[[%PAGE%]] ,\n,</gallery>
</dpl>

== Lore ==


== Spawning ==
On {{Noxious Strain|text}}-invaded planets, Noxious Scavengers and Noxious Spewers replace naturally spawning [[Scavenger]]s and [[Nursing Spewer]]s in [[Minor Places of Interest|Places of Interest]], Mission Objectives, and patrols.

== Behavior ==
Both the [[Noxious Scavenger]] and the [[Noxious Spewer]] will approach the Helldivers to bite them, inflicting the [[Poison]] effect should they succeed. Both have different ways of achieving that:
*The Noxious Scavenger relies on its increased speed.
*The Noxious Spewer will leap to rapidly close the distance.

Furthermore, the Noxious Spewer can also spit web from its belly area to reduce the Helldivers' mobility.

== Tactical Information ==
*Due to the increased speed of the Noxious Scavenger, the ability to leap of the Noxious Spewer, and the Poison effect that can be inflicted by both units. It is recommended that Helldivers maintain distance when fighting this sub-faction.
**Upon a Helldiver becoming poisoned, they will be slowed and suffer the inability to sprint, allowing other Noxious Strain Terminids to close the gap on a Helldiver's position and potentially inflict more doses of poison, worsening the effect.
* Mobility such as the [[Jump Pack]], [[Warp Pack]] and [[Hover Pack]] can enable a Helldiver to safely engage the Noxious Strain from a distance.
* Alternatively, shields such as the [[Shield Generator Backpack]] and [[Ballistic Shield]] can be used to block the attacks of Noxious Strain enemies to prevent being poisoned.
* The [[Muscle Enhancement]] booster can be used to mitigate the slow of the Noxious Terminids, enabling a Helldiver to escape situations where enemies would normally be able to catch up.

{{Quote|This planet has been completely infested by the Terminids, transformed inside and out into a hive of Tyranny. It is a source of Gloom spores.| Galactic Point of Interest Description}}

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a unique [[Terminids|Terminid]] exclusive [[biomes|biome]] that was introduced in the [[Into the Unjust|Into the Unjust Title Update]]. 

== Description ==
{{Quote|This planet has been completely infested by the Terminids, transformed inside and out into a hive of Tyranny.}}

Hive Worlds are artificial biomes created by the {{Terminid}} [[Terminids]]. Planets become Hive Worlds, in that they are so deeply infestated and terraformed that little to no visual proof of the original planet remain. These changes affect topography, weather, the biosphere, and even the waters.

The surfaces of Hive Worlds are covered with yellow sand and bug growths that range from pebbles, to boulders, to massive spires. The surface is covered with bones and parasitic bushes, and is divided by shin-deep lakes of sickly yellow waters. Additionally, massive spore-spewing towers are always seen in the distance, reaching far above the clouds. Though the key component of the Hive Worlds are its massive caves made from bug growth.

Hive World caves are large, craggy structures that penetrate below the ground creating a variety of structures and terrain. Inside the caves there is little light, waist-deep lakes of murky water, and the occasional bottomless pit and the organic bridges crossing them. The caves are home to various bug nests and structures, such as the [[Destroy Spore Lung|Spore Lungs]], believed to be responsible for the creation and expansion of [[The Gloom|The Gloom]]. Caves also feature their very own biosphere, filled with parasitic growths of red grass and hard bushes that resemble the growths on the carapaces of the [[Spore Burst Strain]].

=== Minor Places of Interest ===
Hive Worlds feature their own unique [[Minor Places of Interest]], which usually consist of bug growths, [[Bug Mine]]s and large bones, and feature a large amount of smaller human bones such as skulls. A lesser amount of them feature damaged Super Earth technology, such as a [[Pelican Shuttle]] crashsite, or a small destroyed cave outpost. Larger places of interest will always be guarded by [[Terminids]], regardless of difficulty.

These places of interest are very abundant in Special Resources, such as [[Super Credits]], [[Requisition Slips]], and [[Medals]]. However, they feature little to no [[Supplies]].

== Gameplay ==
* As Hive World caves are covered areas, [[Stratagems]] cannot be called in except for [[Reinforce]], which will automatically deploy reinforcing [[Helldiver]]s at the nearest cave entrance or opening in the cave ceiling. Ceiling openings will allow all other Strategems to be called in as normal. 
** [[Super Destroyer]]s will be prepositioned directly overhead in order to fire Orbital Strategems straight down into the caves.
** Vehicle Strategems may still be blocked if the opening is not big enough for the [[Pelican Shuttle]] to arrive.

Hive Worlds feature their own exclusive [[Missions]] roster, which include the following exclusive missions: [[Conduct Mobile E-711 Extraction]], [[Extract E-711]], [[Destroy Spore Lung]], and [[Restart Pumps]]. Additionally, two side objectives are also exclusively found on Hive worlds, those being: [[Recover SSSD]] and [[Mobile Radar]].

== Environmental Conditions ==
* '''Gloom Source:''' This planet continually produces a thick atmospheric Gloom cover, rendering logistical support extremely challenging. '''Total [[Reinforce|Reinforcements]] are reduced by 20%, [[Eagle Rearm|Eagle Re-arm]] time is increased by 30%, and Ammo from pickups is reduced by 50%.'''
** The Gloom Source modifier is only active while a Hive World planet is located within the Gloom.
* '''[[Roving Shriekers]]:''' Flying [[Shrieker]] swarms traverse the battlefield. (always present in difficulty {{Difficulty|5}} and up)

== Environmental Hazards ==
* Hive Worlds feature underground caves, which are too durable for Hellpods to penetrate, stopping [[Stratagems]] from dropping in.
** [[Reinforce|Reinforcements]] can always be called in, though the reinforced [[Helldiver]] will drop outside the cave system.
** Holes in the ceiling may also allow for the dropping of Stratagems, and reinforced Helldivers may also land there.
* Underground caves can also have ravines and pitfalls, with only an organic bridge to cross them.
** These bridges can be destroyed to stop enemies from coming through.
* [[Bug Mine|Bug Mines]] are present throughout the surface and deep into the underground caves.

== Planets ==

==== Proto Hive Worlds ====

Proto Hive Worlds (unofficial name) are Hive Worlds that feature the same cave megastructures like their Full counterparts, albeit exhibiting their original planet characteristics (such as Fori Prime being a Rocky Canyons biome whilst featuring caves). Additionally, the caves have features that match the biomes they inhabit. However, they can not appear on [[Biomes#Arctic_Biomes|Arctic biomes]]. If not liberated swiftly, these Proto Hive Worlds can develop into fully fledged Hive Worlds.
They have been first sighted during [[Major Orders#A3-11-1|Operation: Serene Guardian]], November 3rd, 2186.

pages.The Gloom:
{{Infobox Lore | image-caption = | image = Gloom Map Affected Areas.png | faction = Terminids | description = | lore_type = }} '''The Gloom''' is an interstellar [[Terminid]] spore cloud that encompasses several star systems. Though the purpose of the cloud is unknown, this unnatural phenomenon obscures galactic map intelligence. == Lore == The Gloom is implied to have been formed in August 2184 by massive spore towers deep within Terminid space following {{MajorOrderLink|id=A1-7-2|text=Major Order A1-7-2}}. During the formation of the spore cloud, Super Earth's research revealed that any vessels that would enter this spore cloud, either manned or unmanned, lost radio contact within minutes of entering it. Research also confirmed, that the Gloom formed as a result of extraordinary evolutionary pressure. Its emergence was minor in the beginning of August of 2184, but the spore cloud quickly grew in magnitude, steadily enveloping entire planets and sectors, preventing Super Earth from gaining any intelligence from them. Due to this, Super Earth could not proactively scan for threats until it was too late, when they were already attacking Super Earth colonies. The Gloom has been shown to heighten mutation in the form of three strains; The {{Predator Strain|text}}, the {{Spore Burst Strain|text}}, and the {{Rupture Strain|text}}. Additionally, it has created the [[Dragonroach]] strain, and de-extincted the former [[Impaler]] and [[Hive Lord]] strains. Following the {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-8-6|text=mass Terminid attack that inspired the other fronts to attack}}, the Helldivers were ordered to {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-8-9|text=liberate one of three Gloom planets for the creation of Outpost Alpha}}. The Helldivers chose to liberate [[Hellmire]]. The establishment of Gloom Base Alpha led the Helldivers to the discovery of the now-terraformed [[Oshaune]]. This was the first instance of a [[Hive World]] being discovered. On October 28th 2185, after Outpost Alpha had been fully upgraded and the {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-9-6|text=DSS had been retrofitted with a new gloom-resistant polymer coating}}, the Helldivers were ordered to {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-10-6|text=liberate Oshaune}}. After a gruesome battle, in the early hours of November 4th 2185, Oshaune was liberated. Almost immediately after its liberation, following the destruction of 99% of Oshaune's Spore Lungs, the remaining Hive Worlds were no longer able to produce enough Gloom spores to maintain its size, causing the Gloom to recede from 8 planets, including Oshaune, though its terraformed crust remained. While little change has been observed, as of October 21st, 2186 spore-spewing geysers have begun to be sighted on all Gloom-affected planets. They are similar to those seen in the backdrop of Hive Worlds, though much smaller as opposed to their sky-scraping counterparts. Their purpose might be similar to the larger ones, though they pose no phyiscal threat to the [[Helldiver]]s. == Biology == The Gloom has shown to mutate the Terminid genome over a long period of time by accelerating or intensifying Terminid mutation, creating advanced, more capable Terminids known as strains. Strains may come in the form of groups with similar capabilities (families), or as singular enemies. One enemy created by The Gloom is the [[Dragonroach]], a sort-of flying [[Bile Titan]]. So far, the Gloom has mutated four different Strains containing multiple, similarly capable enemies: * The {{Predator Strain|text}}, a strain focusing on agility and cloaking. * The {{Spore Burst Strain|text}}, a strain that releases aggravating spores, increasing Terminid agility. * The {{Rupture Strain|text}}, a strain that mainly burrows itself underground, before surfacing to attack. * The {{Noxious Strain|text}}, a strain that specialises in toxin-secreting glands, incapacitating Helldivers with venom. The Gloom has also shown to be able to de-extinct certain Terminid strains, essentially bringing them back from the dead. This has been the case for both the [[Impaler]], and the [[Hive Lord]]. '''Geological/Planetary Changes''' Planets encased by The Gloom are also affected, with changes varying between small environmental changes, to the full on terraforming of a planet's crust. One change which appears on all Gloom planets is the space around it becomes yellow and reflective of light, leading to some planet's now having brighter nights. * '''Environmentally affected planets:''' Most planets encompassed by The Gloom will see little to no geological changes as only the environment is affected. The atmosphere and skies become yellow, the water's reflection causes it to look yellow, the planet's fog turns yellow, and nights are in some cases brighter. In some biomes such as the [[Ionic Crimson]] Moor and the [[Deadlands]], the ground will also look significantly more vibrant and orange. Most [[Environmental Conditions]], specifically those relating to weather (such as [[Rainstorms]] and [[Ion Storms]]), are usually completely absent from the planet. * '''Geologically affected planets:''' Planets that are coated in the Gloom of any level always feature spore geysers that constantly disperse clouds of spores. Some planets located within high-density Gloom space begin undergoing geological changes after being deep within The Gloom for long periods of time, being terraformed into [[Hive World]]s. While what causes a planet to undergo such terraforming is unknown, it can be seen that following the terraforming, most, if not all of the surface of the original planet is completely changed. Hive Worlds are riddled with sand dunes and murky spore-infested waters. Massive Terminid biostructures are present across the entire planet, whether they are rocks, spires, or even entire cave systems reaching deep into the crust. These artificial cave systems are also filled with parasitic red flora not seen anywhere outside of the Hive Worlds. ** Deep within the unnatural caves of Hive Worlds, [[Destroy Spore Lung|Spore Lungs]] can be found which generate Gloom Spores, pumped out into space by massive spire biostructures that reach even above the clouds. Through this, it is deduced that Hive Worlds are the source of The Gloom. '''Element 710 and 711''' * The researchers at the Xenoentomology Center on Turing reported that Gloom-induced mutations may dramatically increase [[Element 710]]-yield, with lab conditions showing a 10x increase. * Researchers stationed on [[Hellmire]] were able to research into a mysterious substance drilled out of the crust of the nearby Hive World planet [[Oshaune]]. After some research, it was concluded the mysterious substance was a more concentrated form of Element 710, after which it was given the name "[[Element 711]]". And by testing the new substance, researchers were able to synthesize [[Dark Fluid]] for the first time from Element 711. == Unique Effects == * '''Light Gloom Cover:''' Gloom particles interfere with landing Pelicans, increasing extraction times by 20 seconds. * '''Moderate Gloom Blanket:''' The Gloom covers this planet completely, obstructing a variety of logistical operations. Extraction times are increased by 30 seconds and Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 20%. * '''Heavy Gloom Shroud:''' This planet is completely engulfed by the Gloom, severely impeding logistical support. Extraction times are increased by 40 seconds, Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 30%. and Ammo from pickups is reduced by 50%.. * '''Gloom Source:''' This planet continually produces a thick atmospheric Gloom cover, rendering logistical support extremely challenging. Total Reinforcements are reduced by 20%, Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 30%, and Ammo from pickups is reduced by 50%. == Planets == 21 planets are currently encompassed by the Gloom: * [[Diaspora X]] * [[Omicron]] * [[Epsilon Phoencis VI]] * [[Zagon Prime]] * [[Enuliale]] * [[Gemstone Bluffs]] * [[Nabatea Secundus]] * [[Navi VII]] * [[Erson Sands]] * [[Socorro III]] * [[Esker]] * [[Fori Prime]] * [[Gacrux]] * [[Acamar IV]] * [[Darius II]] * [[Achernar Secundus]] * [[Crimsica]] * [[Nivel 43]] * [[Fronteria]] * [[Grand Errant]] 8 other planets were formerly encompassed by the Gloom, however the spore nebula has since retreated: * [[Azur Secundus]] * [[Oshaune]] * [[Hellmire]] * [[Overgoe Prime]] * [[Partion]] * [[Estanu]] * [[Erata Prime]] * [[Bore Rock]] == Timeline ==

Paid for with the blood of soldiers and the credits of taxpayers, this technological marvel is Democracy made manifest.|Galactic War Table}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (abbreviated as '''DSS''') is a {{Super Earth|text}} Space Structure. It is designed to aid [[The Helldivers|Helldivers]] in their operations. == Mechanics == The Democracy Space Station's menu can be accessed from the '''Galactic Map''' interface; from there Helldivers can see a summary of the DSS, donate resources to activate powerful '''Tactical Actions''' and also '''vote''' on its next destination. === Moving And Voting === The movement of the DSS is dictated by a majority '''vote'''. Every 4 hours, the Helldivers are given a list of possible planets to vote on. Once the 4-hour period is over the DSS immediately warps to the winning planet's orbit and a new election begins. *If the current [[second Galactic War Mechanics#Liberation_Campaigns|campaign]] ends and there is no longer an active campaign on the orbited planet, the DSS will immediately move to orbit over the next planet with majority of votes. In case of majority vote being "Stay", the DSS will immediately move to the second most voted planet. **In these scenarios the 4-hour-timer however does not reset although Helldivers are given another vote-ticket to use. **In the case of a failed Defense Campaign the DSS will not immediately move if the subsequent Liberation Campaign is accessible. The list of votable planets is updated / refreshed during each movement of the DSS. === Tactical Actions === [[Helldiver|Helldivers]] can donate {{Currency|Requisition}}, as well as {{Currency|Commons}} and {{Currency|Rares}} in order to charge and activate '''Tactical Actions'''. Once fully charged, actions will immediately activate and provide its benefits to all operations occurring on the [[planets and Sectors|planet]] the DSS is orbiting. Each Helldiver can donate resources up to a cap (''separate for each resource'') within a 24-hour cycle; this period begins after the first donation since the end of the last participated cycle for that specific resource. The caps for each 24-hour donation cycle are: * {{Currency|Common Samples|75}} * {{Currency|Requisition|50,000}} * {{Currency|Rare Samples|50}} Only one '''Tactical Action''' can be active at a time. If an action reaches its full charge, it will freeze progress for all other actions until the current one is finished. After a '''Tactical Action''' concludes its 24-hour active period, it will enter cooldown and be ineligible for donations. * Occasionally, Tactical Actions may not be active for the hosting Helldiver during their first mission/gameplay session after booting up the game; this can be double-checked under the "Effects"-info-panel. The aforementioned situation can be rectified by either participating in an ongoing mission or completing a quick and easy/trivial mission first before hosting missions during active Tactical Actions.

== Lore == === Retrieval === The plans for the Democracy Space Station were originally stored inside an Advanced Weapons Lab on [[X-45]] during the [[First Galactic War]], which was abandoned due to dangerous levels of radiation engulfing the planet. Once the radiation levels had decreased during the [[Second Galactic War]], the Helldivers were {{MajorOrderLink|id=A1-7-1|text=tasked with defending the planet}} from [[Automaton]] invasion while the lab was excavated by Super Earth forces in order to recover the plans for the station, as well as an intact cache containing the once lost [[MLS-4X Commando]]s. Upon successful retrieval of the plans, the lab it was formerly contained in was destroyed by Super Earth in order to prevent it from falling into Automaton control. === Construction === After a little over two months of research, construction of the Democracy Space Station was ready to begin. For the first stage of its construction, {{MajorOrderLink|id=A1-9-5|text=the Helldivers were tasked with choosing the location}} of the orbital construction site between either [[Clasa]] or [[Gaellivare]]. Both of these planets were considered suitable due to their large magnetospheres, but both were also under Automaton control, requiring the Helldivers to liberate their planet of choice to secure the site. The majority of Helldivers descended on Gaellivare and ultimately liberated it for the construction of the DSS. ==== Known Issues ==== *Beams in SECTOR 77C lacking structural integrity **Risk of collapse (See attachment A10) *E-710 drive combustion sparks unstable. Risk of self-combustion at use over 33mp/h *Insufficient space for lavatories. Removed to make space for sentry repair units. *Insufficient budget for pressure equalization Current pressure calculation is estimated -235 mmKG *Projections show Bedding for living spaces not within budget reach Donations from Super Citizen Anne's Hospital for Very Sick Children to compensate Reward children with. **[1] time held trip to DSS for heroic sacrifice for Democracy? === Phase 1 === On September 25th, 2184, Upon liberation, a [[DSS Logistics Hub]] on [[Tarsh]] was built to support the mass scale of the construction; Super Earth High Command determined that zero-g materials, FTL propulsion, and gigastructure staffing needed significant advancements to make the DSS a reality. High Command also reminded Helldivers that they would be crucial in the defense of the DSS should it come under attack, and any failures to do so would delay its construction. Soon after establishing the DSS, High Command began tasking the Helldivers to liberate planets to establish facilities for the advancements needed for the DSS. [[Turing]] was selected to build the Ministry of Science's new [[Xenoentomology Center]] for high-efficiency Alcubierre drives. Helldivers quickly liberated the planet from the [[Terminid]] swarm while also defending Tarsh's Logistics Hub. High Command noted that the Center would still need to be defended from any potential attacks or research will be lost. To create FTL-resistant alloy for the DSS, a deep-mantle forge would be required due to the extreme heat and pressure. Luckily, High Command found that the [[Automaton|Automatons]] on [[Claorell]] already had a deep-mantle mining complex. Seeking to repurpose it for their own ends, High Command ordered the Helldivers to liberate Claorell and seize the complex. They would be successful, filling the mines with Super Earth's own in the new [[Deep Mantle Forge Complex]]. However, High Command found intel that revealed that the Automatons were creating exceptionally light metal for armor plating. Not long after, the Automatons attempted to take back Claorell, accompanied by cyberattacks on DSS-related servers. The Helldivers would be successful in defending Claorell; the cyberattacks revealed the DSS project to the Automatons, but the DSS's exact location remained a mystery to them for the time being. === Phase 2 === On September 28th, 2184, with the [[Xenoentomology Center]] and [[Deep Mantle Forge Complex]] built, the DSS moved into Phase 2. Due to the DSS's scale, it would require significant amounts of [[E-710]], leading to the establishment of the [[Terminid Research Preserve]] on [[Acamar IV]]. It would provide research capabilities and another source of E-710. The Helldivers would need to liberate and hold the nearby planets of [[Crimsica]], [[Turing]], [[Darius II]], [[Pandion-XXIV]], and [[Gacrux]] to establish a planetary quarantine zone around Acamar IV. The Helldivers would successfully create the quarantine needed for the construction of the Terminid Research Preserve, furthering E-710 research. Shortly after, the Automatons would launch an assault division, the Jet Brigade, onto numerous planets in search of the DSS. Though the Jet Brigade managed to capture [[Matar Bay]] and [[Martale]], they were eventually stopped on [[Marfark]]. Due to the Helldivers' efforts, the Automatons were unable to find the DSS and its related facilities. To further protect the DSS, High Command determined that liberating [[Lesath]] would provide a defensive buffer for the DSS against a potential Jet Brigade assault. However, a sudden Terminid outbreak on [[Gacrux]] threatened the newly-built Terminid Research Preserve. The Helldivers were then left to decide which to prioritize, in which they chose to liberate Lesath. Another Terminid outbreak would occur on [[Pandion-XXIV]], eventually leading to its fall alongside Gacrux. The DSS would continue to stay protected, but the Terminid Research Preserve quarantine zone was now compromised. === Phase 3 === On October 26th, 2184, the continued protection of the DSS allowed it to advance to its final construction phase before its long-awaited completion. The DSS had to be staffed with a crew of nearly 1.3 million skilled workers. In order to get that many workers, the [[Ministry of Humanity]] authorized the relocation of colonists from [[Terrek]], [[Cirrus]], and [[Angel's Venture]]. Helldivers were ordered to hold these planets, and defend against attacks from within [[The Gloom]], while citizens on them were relocated to serve within the DSS. === Final Phase and Activation === On November 10th, 2184, construction of DSS was completed and the project reached its final phase. The entire construction took 43 days. In order to activate the DSS and fuel it, Helldivers were ordered to kill 500 million Terminids and hold [[Gaellivare]]. However the [[Jet Brigade]] returned, and attacked the [[DSS Logistics Hub]] on [[Tarsh]]. The capture of Tarsh led to the destruction of the Logistics Hub. High Command reported that its loss was negligible, as it had fulfilled its purpose and had an acceptable amount of citizen evacuations. However, they noted that the DSS was finally located by the Automatons, who were now preparing to attack [[Mastia]] to reach [[Gaellivare]]. Upon the culling of 500 million Terminids, the DSS was immediately fueled and activated. It proceeded to travel between various planets as the Jet Brigade attacked, achieving non-zero progress in each case. The DSS Eagle Storm would ultimately buy the citizens of Gaellivare enough time to evacuate before the planet fell into Automaton control. Despite losing the planet, this resulted in a "successful" Major Order win. === Apparent Sabotage and Deactivation === The DSS would patrol the Galaxy for the next several weeks, resulting in a quantifiable effect on the Galactic War. It cannot be argued that the DSS had zero effect, or that it was in fact negative for the forces on the ground. With the return of the [[the Illuminate|Illuminate]] and their {{MajorOrderLink|id=A1-12-3|text=attack}} on [[Calypso]]. The Democracy Space Station would undergo multiple catastrophic system failures, with the damage being severe enough to render it inoperable. The DSS was locked down for repairs. Security screening measures had been drastically increased. This sabotage, manifested in failure to follow security protocols, would later be attributed to Illuminate mind control. The DSS would remain marooned in orbit of [[Vog-Sojoth]] for over a month, unable to aid in the Galactic War against the return of the Illuminate. === Reactivation and Operational Adjustments === Necessary repairs would eventually bring the station online without further complications. Notably, its drives would receive a comprehensive recalibration, allowing the station to move every 4 hours rather than daily. This change was made to help better confront the swift pace of Illuminate attacks, and are under review for long term application. The DSS would exit Automaton space and begin coursing threatened planets at 6 times its previous speed. Beyond restoring basic functionality, these repairs would see tweaks to some core systems. In particular, the Planetary Bombardment tactical action would be temporarily retired so as to adjust certain lethal externalities caused by the ceaseless bombardment from the 77 PRESIDENTIAL-Class cannons installed on the DSS. A new tactical action with similar effects would take its place, with Heavy Ordnance Distribution providing the surplus [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage]] stratagems to all Helldivers in the field. During [[Major Orders#A2-3-7|Major Order A2-3-7]] after the liberation of [[Ingmar]], it was also revealed the warp drives had been given enhancements to immediately deploy next planet after each completed campaign rather having to wait to cooldown recharge between each jump. === Upgrades === Following the [[Major Orders#A2-3-7|successful defense]] of [[Malevelon Creek]], upgrades to the DSS became a priority due to its pivotal role in holding [[Pöpli IX]]. Helldivers were ordered to [[Major Orders#A2-4-1|secure resources for the upgrade]], by liberating either [[Wezen]] to enable the construction of an Exosuit Support Bay, or [[Trandor]] for an Expanded Convocation Bay. Upon the liberation of the [[Automatons|Automaton]] factories on Wezen, the Exosuit Support Bay was installed immediately, reducing the cooldown of Exosuit [[Stratagems]]. === Second Deactivation === {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-5-2|text=During the true Illuminate invasion}} on [[Widow's Harbor]], Super Earth High Command reported in a dispatch that the DSS, which was orbiting the planet, received damage from the Illuminate. High Command warned that further warps to Illuminate-invaded planets could potentially deal additional damage. Despite their warning, the Helldivers would vote for the DSS to warp to [[Pilen V]] soon after the fall of Widow's Harbor. The Illuminate immediately attacked the DSS upon its arrival to Pilen V, inflicting significant damage to the station and killing many of its crew. The DSS would retreat to [[Claorell]] for repairs, though Super Earth High Command noted that it is undetermined of when the DSS would be fully operational. === Second Reactivation & Surge into Action === After receiving sufficient repairs due to {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-5-5|text=Helldivers collecting Automation scrap}}, as ordered by High Command, the DSS immediately left for Super Earth without delay. Upon reaching Super Earth, it began supporting the struggling defense against the Illuminate invasion. In order to avoid a repeat of its previous near-destruction, high command initialized a Fleet Positioning Protocol, creating a barrier of ships around the DSS to defend it against enemy fighter attacks. === Star of Peace === Following the construction of the [[Center for the Confinement of Dissidence]], Super Earth High Command ordered the construction of [[Pandora Base]] within [[Afoyay Bay]]. The new top-secret base would utilize the Dissident's labor in order to accomplish one of [[Major_Orders#January_2026|Operation Free Space]]'s main goals: a major augmentation of the DSS called ''Star of Peace''. Such upgrade's centerpiece was the installation of an ionized ''"The centerpiece of this Operation is the Star of Peace, created to augment the Democracy Space Station.'' ''Its primary weapon is a cutting-edge beam of ionized Dark Fluid."'' - {{MajorOrderLink|id=A3-1-1|text= Major Order A3-1-1 briefing}} [[Dark Fluid]] beam capable of {{MajorOrderLink|id=A3-1-4|text=collapsing an entire planet}} into a black hole. [[Strohmann_News#Star of Peace Announced|Strohmann News broadcast: Star of Peace Announced]][[Strohmann News#Star of Peace Completes Test Fire|Strohmann News broadcast: Star of Peace Completes Test Fire]] On January 14th, 2186, after {{MajorOrderLink|id=A3-1-1|text=barely collecting enough E-711 from Omicron}} and {{MajorOrderLink|id=A3-1-2|text=successfully collecting platinum and scrapping Automaton components}}, the [[Democracy Space Station#Star of Peace|Star of Peace]] would be able to be fired once in order to turn an entire planet into a black hole using synthesized [[Dark Fluid]]. The choices were between [[Penta]], [[Zagon Prime]], and [[Valmox]]. When the Star of Peace reached operational status, the Helldivers elected for Penta to be used as the demonstration for test-firing. On January 18th, 2186, day 711 of the Galactic War, at 21:28 SEST, Penta would be destroyed and turned into a [[Conventional Black Hole]], a normal, stable black hole much unlike the [[Meridian Black Hole|Meridian Singularity]]. === Operation Valid Pretext=== On February 10th, 2186, the DSS would be deployed on [[Cyberstan]] as part of [[Operation Valid Pretext]], providing support to Helldivers and SEAF forces on the planet. On February 15th, 2186, the DSS would be sent to [[Fort Justice]] briefly to recover 35,000,000 Helldivers in cryostasis stored in warehouses. The DSS remained on the planet for 12 hours before returning with the 35,000,000 Helldivers. On February 19th, 2186, seeing Operation Valid Pretext's failure was imminent, High Command activated the '''TERMINAL DIRECTIVE''', initiating the DSS' Planetary Bombardment tactical action for 48 hours. == Description == === Phase 1 === {{Quote|Construction has begun on the Democracy Space Station. The local populace is honored to host thousands of construction crews for this historic event.}} === Phase 2 === {{Quote|Democracy Space Station construction is well underway. The local economy is flourishing as the planet's populace has centupled, and all the Galaxy can feel their democratic fervor.}} === Phase 3 === {{Quote|Construction of the Democracy Space Station is nearing completion. This project, which has employed millions, will soon take its place among the greatest achievements of Democracy.}} === Final Phase === {{Quote|A Helldiver-operated weapon of mass liberation. Paid for with the blood of soldiers and the credits of taxpayers, this technological marvel is Democracy made manifest.}} == Trivia == * Despite requiring over 1.3 million skilled workers to sustain operations ''"The Democracy Space Station is currently in its third construction phase. In [[Helldivers 2]], each [[Planets and Sectors|Planet]] has a single '''Biome''' that determines its layout and [[Environmental Conditions]]. 

==Naming==

It should be noted that while the biomes do have names internally, they're not suitable for describing what to actually expect from each planet.  As such, all biomes are given a community nickname along with their internal names.

== Biome Archetypes ==

Most biomes belong to a specific archetype, with which they share common features. 
* Sandy
* Moor
* Arctic
* Primordial
* Swamp
* Forest
* Oasis
* City

==Sandy Biomes==

{{Breadcrumb Auto
 | parent = Biomes
 | title = Sandy Biomes
 | overview = Biomes
 | no_crumbs = True
 | page_override = Biomes#Sandy Biomes
}}

Sandy biomes are rocky/sandy, generally with little vegetation.
{{BiomeBox|Desert Dunes|Desert Cliffs|Acidic Badlands|Rocky Canyons|Moon}}

==Primordial Biomes ==

{{Breadcrumb Auto
 | parent = Biomes
 | title = Primordial Biomes
 | overview = Biomes
 | no_crumbs = True
 | page_override = Biomes#Primordial Biomes
}}
Primordial biomes are thick jungles brimming with life (with exceptions).
{{BiomeBox|Volcanic Jungle|Deadlands|Ethereal Jungle|Ionic Jungle}}

==Arctic Biomes ==

{{Breadcrumb Auto
 | parent = Biomes
 | title = Arctic Biomes
 | overview = Biomes
 | no_crumbs = True
 | page_override = Biomes#Arctic Biomes
}}

Characterized by their icy, chilly climates.
{{BiomeBox|Icy Glaciers|Boneyard}}

==Moor Biomes ==

{{Breadcrumb Auto
 | parent = Biomes
 | title = Moor Biomes
 | overview = Biomes
 | no_crumbs = True
 | page_override = Biomes#Moor Biomes
}}

Characterized by open fields and rolling plains.  Moor biomes feature the "[[Moor Mushroom]]," a unique piece of flora which explodes into a smoky cloud when shot.
{{BiomeBox|Plains|Tundra|Scorched Moor|Ionic Crimson}}

==Swamp Biomes ==

{{Breadcrumb Auto
 | parent = Biomes
 | title = Swamp Biomes
 | overview = Biomes
 | no_crumbs = True
 | page_override = Biomes#Swamp Biomes
}}

Swamp biomes are characterized by dense forests with tall trees that can block certain aerial support [[stratagems]].
{{BiomeBox|Basic Swamp|Haunted Swamp}}

==Forest Biomes ==

{{Breadcrumb Auto
 | parent = Biomes
 | title = Forest Biomes
 | overview = Biomes
 | no_crumbs = True
 | page_override = Biomes#Forest Biomes
}}

Forest biomes are characterized by dense forests with large grassy clearings, and being overall calmer and safer than other biomes.
{{BiomeBox|Deciduous Forest|Autumn Forest|Crimson Forest}}

==Oasis Biomes ==
{{Breadcrumb Auto
 | parent = Biomes
 | title = Oasis Biomes
 | overview = Biomes
 | no_crumbs = True
 | page_override = Biomes#Oasis Biomes
}}
Oasis biomes are characterized by extensive sandy dunes that feature palm-like trees, ferns, the occasional grassy patches, and ponds/lakes of shin-deep water.

{{BiomeBox|Desert Oasis|Bleak Oasis}}

==Special Biomes ==
{{Breadcrumb Auto
 | parent = Biomes
 | title = City Biomes
 | overview = Biomes
 | no_crumbs = True
 | page_override = Biomes#City Biomes
}}
In addition to standard Metropolis generation, [[Super Earth]] has its own unique biome.

{{BiomeBox|Super Earth Metropolis}}

=== Terminid Specific Biomes ===
{{Breadcrumb Auto
 | parent = Biomes
 | title = Bug Biomes
 | overview = Biomes
 | no_crumbs = True
 | page_override = Biomes#Terminid Specific Biomes
}}
The Terminids have two unique Special Biomes that appear on very few planets.

{{BiomeBox|Hive World|Supercolony}}

=== Automaton Specific Biomes ===
{{Breadcrumb Auto
 | parent = Biomes
 | title = Bot Biomes
 | overview = Biomes
 | no_crumbs = True
 | page_override = Biomes#Automaton Specific Biomes
}}
The Automatons have two Special Biomes that appears on very few planets.

{{BiomeBox|Magma Desert|Cyberstan Megafactory}}

=== Illuminate Specific Biomes ===
{{Breadcrumb Auto
 | parent = Biomes
 | title = Squid Biomes
 | overview = Biomes
 | no_crumbs = True
 | page_override = Biomes#Illuminate Specific Biomes
}}
The Illuminate have one Special Biome that appears on one planet.

{{BiomeBox|Void Forest}}

== Common Biome Locations ==
Randomly generated megastructures can occasionally be found within each biome.  However, they are not considered any kind of sub biome.

{{Breadcrumb Auto
 | parent = Biomes
 | title = Megastructures
 | overview = Biomes
 | no_crumbs = True
 | page_override = Biomes#Urban Megastructures
}}

=== Urban Megastructures ===
[[Metropolis]]es and [[Automaton Megafactory|Megafactories]] are a type of planet [[Regions|Region]] characterized by giantbuildings that often block stratagems. As such, [[Super Destroyer]]s automatically relocate to a position where it is able to hit the intended location. [[Eagle]]s may reposition slightly to hit as much open ground as possible, and [[Pelican]]s delivering [[Exosuit]]s/[[FRV]]s try to find an open, unrestricted area nearby to drop their cargo.
{{BiomeBox|Metropolis|Automaton Megafactory}}

Colonies replace sections of the main Biome, and generate different variants of objectives, enemy bases, and Minor Places of Interest. Colonies retain the environmental effects of the main Biome.
{{BiomeBox|Colonies}}

==Trivia==
* [[Environmental Conditions]] are tied to each individual planet, not the biome.  This can be best seen on [[Tien Kwan]], which has an additional [[Meteor Storms]] hazard.
* A planet's biome can change to another following a patch (as seen with Gacrux and X-45 changing to the [[Basic Swamp]] biome) or specific in game circumstances, such as the [[Terminid Control System]] terraforming [[Meridia]] into a [[Supercolony]].

* Arid planets (similar to the Hellmire planet) will now only have the Intense Heat modifier active during fire tornado storms
}}

The {{Predator Strain}}'''Predator Strain''' is an enemy subfaction of enhanced [[Terminids]] originating from [[The Gloom]]. The Predator Strain consists of the [[Predator Hunter]] and [[Predator Stalker]].

== Enemies ==

== Lore ==
{{Quote|A Gloom-enhanced strain of Terminids has been reported on this planet. SEAF patrols have been lured into ambushes, and picked off by unseen assailants. Every ounce of a Helldiver's superior senses will be required to hunt down this dangerous threat.|Original Galactic War Table Description}}

The Predator Strain was first encountered on [[Fenrir III]], when {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-2-3|text=Terminids attacked the Center of Science}}.  

Scattered reports on the new Terminids indicate discoloration, increased intelligence, and drastic changes to hunting patterns. Information remains scarce, as no SEAF units have returned from close encounters. 

This variant group has been dubbed the Predator Strain.

== Spawning ==
The spawning mechanics of Predator Strain work similarly to the [[Automaton]] [[Jet Brigade]]. On Predator Strain invaded planets, Predator Stalkers and Predator Hunters commonly replace naturally spawning [[Warrior|Warriors]], [[Hive Guard|Hive Guards]] and regular [[Hunter|Hunters]] respectively in [[Minor Places of Interest|Places of Interest]], Mission Objectives, and patrols. 

Additionally, [[Stalker Lair]]s are more common throughout the map of an operation invaded with the Predator Strain.{{citation needed}}

== Behavior ==
The Predator Strain Terminid variants exhibit increased flanking capabilities and modified spawn conditions.

Whilst the Predator Stalkers cannot cloak compared to their purebreed Stalker brethren, the sheer increase in their numbers and natural spawn rates can easily overwhelm an unprepared Helldiver.

Predator Hunters are vastly different compared to their regular counterparts. This Hunter variety possesses cloaking abilities and a highly staggering tongue-lash attack, similar to traditional Stalkers. They're also able to spit small clusters of bile similarly to [[Caustic Spitter]]s and [[Caustic Spewer]]s. 

== Tactical Information ==
* Due to the Predator Strain being much faster than normal Terminids, Helldivers should stick together and mass firepower on the Predators to avoid being picked off one-by-one.
* Use weapons with high staggering properties, such as the [[SG-8 Punisher]] and its variants, or the [[ARC-12 Blitzer|Arc-12 Blitzer]] in order to knock back and nullify the Terminids' increased mobility.
* Persistent damage effects such as Napalm and Gas can negate the cloaking capabilities of the Predator Hunters. Options include the [[AX/TX-13 "Guard Dog" Dog Breath]], [[G-4 Gas|G4-Gas]], [[SG-225IE Breaker Incendiary]] and [[SG-451 Cookout]]. 
** Gas effects in particular are able to disorient and disperse the Predator Stalkers and Hunters to flee in different directions with their increased speed, scattering and taking them out of the fight to later pick off individually.

The {{Rupture Strain|text}} is an enemy subfaction of reinforced, burrowing Terminids originating from [[The Gloom]], similarly to the [[Predator Strain]] and [[Spore Burst Strain]]. The {{Rupture Strain}} Rupture Strain is composed of [[Rupture Warrior]]s, [[Rupture Spewer]]s, and [[Rupture Charger]]s.

== Enemies ==

  category=Rupture Strain Terminids

== Lore ==
{{Quote|A product of Gloom-induced mutation, the Rupture Warrior has lost the UV-insulating chitin layer that would protect its internal organs from solar radiation damage. Captured specimens prefer burrowing to open-air movement, a pattern indicative of subconscious shame at their own undemocratic ways.|[[https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/553850/view/516345493302805199| Steam blog for Into The Unjust]]}}
The Rupture Strain was first encountered during the expeditions into the Terminid Hive Worlds. Rupture Strain was initially only found inside [[The Gloom]] on [[Hive World|Hive Worlds]], but can potentially appear on any planet today. 

A Gloom-induced mutation, the Rupture Strain Terminids have lost the UV-insulating chitin layer that would protect its internal organs from solar radiation damage. As such, this new species have been found in the deep caves of the Terminid Hive Worlds.

== Spawning ==
On Rupture Strain invaded planets, Rupture Warriors, Rupture Spewers, and Rupture Chargers replace naturally spawning [[Warrior|Warriors]], [[Nursing Spewer|Nursing Spewers]], and [[Charger|Chargers]] in [[Minor Places of Interest|Places of Interest]], Mission Objectives, and patrols.

Rupture Strain enemies can only appear on Difficulty 6{{Difficulty|6}}, meaning that on lower difficulties, these planets simply lack [[Warrior|Warriors]] or [[Nursing Spewer|Nursing Spewers]]. The result is often groups of [[Hunter|Hunters]] often led by a [[Brood Commander]] that do not call in reinforcements. Brood and [[Alpha Commander|Alpha Commanders]] at sufficient difficulty produce Rupture Warriors instead of Warriors.

== Behavior ==
Rupture Terminids have the special ability to burrow into the ground and ambush Helldivers. Each of the Rupture Strain Terminids acts in a different way but they all commonly burrow into the ground to approach Helldivers.

While underground, Rupture Strain Terminids are shielded from most damage except for ongoing effects (fire and gas) and explosives.

*Warriors and Chargers will burrow toward a Helldiver and Warriors attempt an lunging strike while emerging.
* Spewers attempt to reach a medium distance to emerge in a stationary, half-submerged state where they will lob short-range area-of-effect acid balls.

== Tactical Information ==
* {{armor|3|ap}} penetration weapons are much more valuable on planets with this strain than against other Terminid lineups, as the common Rupture Warriors and Rupture Spewers both are coated in medium armor, including the heads.
* When burrowing underground, Rupture Strain Terminids will telegraph their position in the form of moving rubble. Charger rubble is much larger and spewers do not chase up to close quarters, so these can be used to distinguish which enemy is present.
** Because warriors lunge when they emerge, Helldivers should dive away from an attack if a burrowing foe gets within claw-range.
* Burrowing units can be forced to surface by any explosive (assuming they survive it).
** This includes primary weapons with the 'explosive' trait such as the [[CB-9 Exploding Crossbow|Crossbow]], [[PLAS-1 Scorcher|Scorcher]], or [[PLAS-101 Purifier|Purifier]], secondary weapons such as the [[GP-31 Grenade Pistol|Grenade Pistol]] or [[PLAS-15 Loyalist|Loyalist]], and any grenade that can blow up a [[Bug Hole]]. The [[G-23 Stun]] will force the [[Rupture Warrior]] to the surface in a stunned state.
** Grenades with very large area of effect, such as the [[TED-63 Dynamite]], may force groups to surface. Meanwhile, the [[G-16 Impact]] allows for more flexible unburrowing due to the lack of fuse.
** Support weapons with easy access to explosions, such as the [[GL-21 Grenade Launcher]], [[GL-28 Belt-Fed Grenade Launcher]], and [[S-11 Speargun]] are also very useful to drive out burrowers.
*Burrowed units cannot be set on fire or confused with gas, but continue to be damaged if they were already afflicted and can die underground. Gassed Rupture Strain Terminids rarely burrow, however.
*Burrowed units are protected from run-over damage by [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]] and [[Tank (disambiguation)|Tanks]]. However, Warriors tend to immediately emerge underneath both and die instantly as they are no longer protected.
*Burrowed units may not be targeted by [[A/M-12 Mortar Sentry]] fire, but it often will hit (and force surfacing) burrowed Rupture Terminids who are near other unburrowed hostiles, or who linger close to where they burrowed (especially Rupture Spewers). 
**It is not possible to ping a burrowed unit, so directing fire not possible either. Pings before burrowing persist normal duration and work as usual.
*Burrowed units may not be targeted by red stratagems, such as the [[Orbital Railcannon Strike]] or [[Eagle 110mm Rocket Pods]] upon a Rupture Charger. However, indiscriminate fire from a [[Eagle Cluster Bomb]] will still kill burrowed Rupture Warriors.

== Trivia ==
* The Rupture Strain was the first enemy subfaction to be explicitly disabled by Arrowhead. While other subfactions have become unavailable (fleet eliminated, only appearing on limited planets, etc.), they were [https://discord.com/channels/1102970375731691612/1102974129734434919/1417868662785703957 disabled for a period of time] in order to resolve unintended balancing.
** They were disabled on September 17th, 2025 and returned on October 23rd, 2025.

pages.Spore Burst Strain: {{Infobox Subfaction | title = Spore Burst Strain | image = Spore Burst Strain Icon.svg | faction = Terminids }} {{Quote|A mutation causes Terminids on this planet to generate excess hormonal spores, which drive other similarly mutated Terminids into a frenzy. Prepare to face enemies that bolster each others' speed.|Galactic War Table Description}} The '''{{Spore Burst Strain|text}}''' is an enemy subfaction of exploding Terminids originating from [[The Gloom]], similarly to the [[Predator Strain]] and the [[Rupture Strain]]. The Spore Burst Strain is composed of [[Spore Burst Scavenger]]s, [[Spore Burst Warrior]]s, [[Spore Burst Hunter]]s, and [[Spore Burst Bile Titan]]s. Patrols of Terminids in this subfaction are remarkably bigger, and appear approximately twice as frequently as regular Terminids. Spore Burst Terminids are notable in that they are much faster than regular Terminids; additionally, when killed, Spore Burst Terminids have a small explosion of splash damage similar to Bile Terminids when killed, and also creating a small red cloud of spores that further speed up fellow Terminids who move through it. With their speed and great herd sizes, Spore Burst Terminids can easily overwhelm Helldivers. == Enemies == category=Spore Burst Strain Terminids notcategory=Subfactions uses=Template:Infobox Enemy mode=userformat ordermethod=sortkey format=,File:%PAGE% Enemy Icon.png|[[%PAGE%]] ,\n, == Lore == The Spore Burst Strain was first encountered during the [[First Gloom Expedition]]. Spore Burst Strain could formerly only be found inside The Gloom, which means that this Strain is Terminids who adapted to the new environment. As [[Super Earth]] began making strides to allow Helldivers to infiltrate the Gloom, the Terminids responded in kind, {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-7-7|text=attacking planets needed for these scientific advancements}}, requiring Helldivers to both defend the required planets and collect rare samples from the [[Jin Xi Sector]]. Helldivers could see Spore Burst Terminids for the first time in one of the Strohmann News Clips. {{VideoBox | title = First Sighting of Spore Burst Terminids | file = Strohmann News Helldivers Conduct First Ever Gloom Expedition.mp4 }} === Mutation === On April 28th 2186 after nearly a year of the Spore Burst Strain being discovered, the spores released by dead Spore Burst Terminids would mutate, causing any other nearby Spore Burst Terminids that inhaled the spores to receive a speed boost for a short while. This also came with a new member of the Strain being mutated: the [[Spore Burst Bile Titan]]. The new mutation was first observed during {{MajorOrderLink|id=A3-4-8|text=Major Order A3-4-8}} on the planets [[Brilliance]] and [[Luxuriant]], leading to the Strain to now actually be recognized on the Galactic War Map. == Spawning == On planets where the Spore Burst Strain is present, Spore Burst Terminids will replace regular Terminids. On {{Difficulty|1}} difficulty, Spore Burst Strain won't appear, but the higher the difficulty, the more Spore Burst Terminids will appear, eventually replacing all natural Terminids, except for Hive Guards, on {{Difficulty|10}}. == Behavior == Spore Burst Terminids move faster and generally behave identically to their standard counterparts. * Upon death, Spore Burst Terminids will release a cloud of spores, damaging nearby Helldivers, disrupting vision, and buffing nearby Spore Burst Terminids. ** When entering a cloud of spores (created by another Spore Burst Terminid’s death or through the [[Spore Burst Bile Titan]]’s bile spew), Spore Burst Terminids will gain a significant increase in speed, allowing them to close the gap on Helldivers. * Gas and Fire weapons such as the [[AX/TX-13 Dog Breath]], [[FLAM-40 Flamethrower]], and [[B/FLAM-80 Cremator]] can slow and deter Spore Burst Terminids from a Helldiver's position, allowing them to more easily avoid attacks and spore explosions. ** Spore Burst Terminids '''do not release their spores if they die while burning'''. This makes continuous laser weapons (such as the [[LAS-5 Scythe]]) and Fire weapons useful to avoid enraging a horde of Spore Burst Terminids. * Crowd control [[Stratagems]] such as [[MD-8 Gas Mines]], [[A/M-23 EMS Mortar Sentry]], [[Orbital EMS Strike]], and [[A/ARC-3 Tesla Tower]] are especially effective at slowing down Spore Burst Terminids, preventing them from using their increased speed to engage Helldivers. * Using [[Weapons#Melee-0|melee weapons]] against Spore Burst Terminids is not recommended, as repeated spore explosions will stagger and eventually kill an ignorant Helldiver. * Despite its passive effect, [[Armor]] with the [[Acclimated]] or [[Desert Stormer]] passives are not very effective against Spore Burst Terminids, as they provide limited utility against the already low damage spore explosions. == Gallery ==

The {{Jet Brigade}}'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (abbreviated as '''JB''') is an {{Automatons}}[[Automatons|Automaton]] subfaction. They are enhanced variants of various Automaton infantry, equipped with jump-packs that grant them increased mobility and aggressive capabilities.

== Lore ==
{{Quote|The Automatons have deployed a new series of specialized models on this planet. These upgraded bots utilize stolen Jump-Pack technology, heartlessly pillaged from the bodies of fallen Helldivers and reverse-engineered into something nearly unrecognizable.|Original Galactic War Table Description}}

The Jet Brigade is a limited Automaton division serving as a blitz invasion force used to rapidly take and overwhelm planets, quickly subduing them before moving to the next planet. The Jet Brigade has a limited amount of units that take losses for each planet they successfully overwhelm, making each consecutive attack weaker and weaker.

=== Origin of the Jet Brigade ===
Super Earth High Command first discovered the Jet Brigade's existence after intercepting Automaton communications. In {{MajorOrderLink|id=A1-9-2|text=Major Order A1-9-2}}, the Automatons would attack [[Imber]] for its titanium repositories solely for the construction of the strike force. Despite the successful defense of Imber by [[The Helldivers]], High Command found through decrypted intel that the strike force's construction would continue, despite the setback.

=== First Appearance and The DSS ===
In October of 2184, the Automatons would discover intel on the [[DSS]] project and how it was being constructed somewhere near Automaton-controlled space.

As part of their efforts to discover the construction site, the Jet Brigade would be dispatched for the first time, quickly invading [[Matar Bay]] and [[Martale]] during {{MajorOrderLink|id=A1-10-4|text=Major Order A1-10-4}}, before being stopped in [[Marfark]]. This would mark the first appearance of the Jet Brigade.

In early November of 2184 and during {{MajorOrderLink|id=A1-11-2|text=Major Order A1-11-2}}, the Automatons would construct another Jet Brigade division, amassing its forces on [[Vernen Wells]] in order to mobilize on [[Tarsh]], the site of the [[DSS Logistics Hub]]. By the time Tarsh fell, they would discover the DSS' construction site, [[Gaellivare]]. The Jet Brigade would then mobilize into [[Mastia]], overwhelming it as the Automatons neared Gaellivare. Once the Jet Brigade reached Gaellivare, they would be overwhelmed by the finalized Democracy Space Station as their forces were quickly decimated.

=== The Jet Brigade Factories ===
Jet Brigade divisions are constructed at the [[Jet Brigade Factories]] which encompass an entire planet.

The former site located on [[Chort Bay]], was destroyed in January of 2186 during {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-1-5|text=A2-1-5}}. The Jet Brigade would attempt to stop the attack by amassing on [[Menkent]] and staging an invasion of [[Lesath]] in order to cut off the attack on the factories. This would be thwarted by the Democracy Space Station, with both the factories and the division being destroyed.

In February of 2185, they would construct a new factory site on [[Aurora Bay]].

=== Unit Roster Expansion ===
During {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-6-6|text=Major Order A2-6-6}}, the Jet Brigade would launch a major offensive across the [[Marspira Sector|Marspira]], [[Sagan Sector|Sagan]], and [[Nanos Sector]]s. The offensive would feature an expanded Jet Brigade unit roster comprised of jetpack-assisted [[Devastator]] and [[Hulk]] units.

=== Notable Appearances ===
The Jet Brigade is rarely dispatched during Major Orders, though they have made a few key appearances. Namely to aid the unsuccessful invasion of [[Pöpli IX]] during {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-3-7|text=Major Order A2-3-7}}, the invasion of planets weakened by {{Illuminate|text}} during {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-4-6|text=Major Order A2-4-6}}, and the defense of [[Chort Bay]], [[Aurora Bay]] and [[Merak]] during Phase One of [[Operation Valid Pretext]].

The Jet Brigade would also be present as a permanent force on two of [[Cyberstan|Cyberstan's]] [[Megafactories]]: STAR KIELD and TRANSCENDENCE.

== Spawning ==
On Jet Brigade invaded planets, the Jet Brigade will often replace [[Trooper]]s, [[Commissar]]s, [[MG Raider]]s, [[Assault Raider]]s, [[Devastator]]s, and [[Hulk]]s, with [[Rocket Raider|Rocket Raiders]] being the only exception for Trooper Type Automatons. 

On lower difficulties, Jet Brigade variants only partially replace the standard units. From Challenging and above, all affected unit types are present in their Jet Brigade variation.

They can spawn naturally, from [[Dropship]]s, or from both types of Fabricators (regular [[Automaton Fabricator|Fabricator]]s and [[Bulk Fabricator|Bulk Fabricators]]).

== Behavior ==
Jet Brigade units behave similarly to their original counterparts, but utilize jump-packs to aggressively close the distance to [[The Helldivers|Helldivers]].

* They prioritize close-quarters combat, using jump packs to leap rapidly into melee range.
* Their jump-packs explode when destroyed.
** Exploding jump packs instantly kill smaller units.
** [[Devastator]]s can survive jump pack explosions; [[Hulk]]s will die but their packs take more damage to destroy.
** Exploding jump-packs cause damage and can light nearby units on fire, harming Helldivers and other enemies alike.

== Tactical Information ==
* The Jet Brigade’s mobility compensates for the traditional Automaton weakness: slow movement.
** Units can leap great distances without warning and at high speed.
** They can evade stratagems such as the [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]] or [[Orbital Precision Strike]] by jumping clear before impact.
* Exploding jump packs are volatile and can trigger chain reactions in groups.
** Fighting them at close range is risky, as a single kill could set a Helldiver on fire.
** Jump pack explosions can draw attention, and Helldivers attempting [[Stealth]] should be careful to aim for the head to avoid this.
* Jump packs are weaker than the units wearing them and are particularly vulnerable to explosive damage from the front.
** [[Hulk]]s, while extremely durable, have been observed exploding from a single shot from weapons not traditionally known for armor piercing capability, such as the [[RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher]] due to the explosive force of their jump packs.

==Trivia==

* The Jet Brigade features a polished chrome-black color scheme, eschewing many red highlights commonly found on Automaton units. This design decision may be a play on the word 'jet-black', describing a deep black color.

pages.Incineration Corps: {{Infobox Subfaction | title = {{PAGENAME}} | image = Incineration Corps Icon.svg | image_caption = | faction =Automatons | min_difficulty = {{Difficulty|1}} | EnemyID = }} {{Quote|An Automaton unit equipped with flame throwers and incendiary ammunition is active on this planet. Prepare to face wanton arsonists who will not rest until they have razed all that humankind holds dear. |Galactic War Table Description}} The {{Incineration Corps}}'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (abbreviated as '''IC''') are an {{Automaton}} [[Automatons|Automaton]] subfaction. They are identified by their red and white color scheme, and are equipped with incendiary weapons. ==Enemies== category=Incineration Corps notcategory=Subfactions uses=Template:Infobox Enemy mode=userformat ordermethod=sortkey format=,File:%PAGE% Enemy Icon.png|[[%PAGE%]] ,\n, ==Lore== {{Quote|An Automaton unit equipped with flame throwers and incendiary ammunition is active on this planet. These wanton arsonists will not rest until they have razed all that humankind holds dear. |Original Galactic War Table Description}} The Super Earth High Command first discovered the new Automaton forces when they landed on several planets in what appeared to be a coordinated large-scale attack. This unit was dubbed the {{IconPOI|Incineration Corps Icon.png}}'''{{PAGENAME}}'''. The Incineration Corps landed on several colonies and burned them to the ground. While the Helldivers intervened in this offensive, numerous colonies and homesteads were lost as the Incineration Corps ravaged multiple sectors, gaining significant swaths of territory and enabling further offensives. The Incineration Corps remains one of the Automatons' primary attacking forces. Often being supported by the [[Jet Brigade]]. ==Spawning== Incineration Corps Automatons will only spawn on planets they are invading. [[Incendiary Rocket Raider]], starting on {{Difficulty|4}}, are armed with an energy cannon, firing a projectile similar to that of the [[Bunker Turret]], which can cause [[Helldiver]]s to trip. In addition, other light Automatons can now throw incendiary grenades. Notably, [[Rocket Raider]]s and [[Assault Raider]]s are not found on Incineration Corps invaded planets. [[Pyro Trooper]]s are light Automatons equipped with flamethrowers, and can be found on all difficulties. [[Berserker|Berserkers]] are absent from Incineration Corps missions entirely, their role functionally fulfilled by Pyro Troopers. [[Conflagration Devastator]]s and [[Incendiary MG Devastator]]s replace [[Heavy Devastator]]s, and can be found on {{Difficulty|1}} and {{Difficulty|3}} respectively. The Conflagration Devastator is armed with an incendiary shotgun, and the Incendiary MG Devastator an incendiary machine gun. Both are also equipped with a large ballistic shield. The standard Devastator still appears, though bearing the livery of the Inceration Corps. [[Hulk Firebomber]]s can be first found on {{Difficulty|4}}, and will replace [[Hulk Bruiser]]s, and occasionally [[Hulk Scorcher]]s. They are armed with an incendiary grenade launcher and a flamethrower. ==Tactical Information== *The [[SH-32 Shield Generator Pack]] can stop incendiary rounds, protecting [[Helldiver]]s from being burnt. *[[Armor Passives#Inflammable|Inflammable]] and [[Acclimated]] armor passives will provide a resistance to fire damage. ** Helldivers should note that this will not reduce the ballistic damage of the incendiary projectile itself. ==Trivia== *[[Marauder]]s, [[MG Raider]]s, [[Commissar]]s, [[Devastator]]s, [[Rocket Devastator]]s, and [[Hulk Scorcher]]s that spawn on planets that the Incineration Corps are invading have their color scheme, but are functionally the same. *In the video posted to the official Twitter page on April 8th, 2026, the Hulk Firebomber's flag is missing. ==Gallery==

They are descendants of the {{Cyborgs}} [[Helldivers 1:Cyborgs|Cyborgs]] from the [[First Galactic War]]. == Overview == {{Quote|FREEDOM. YOU ENSLAVED US IN THE NAME OF FREEDOM. YOU TRIED TO ERADICATE US IN THE NAME OF FREEDOM. WE ENDURED. WE SURVIVED. WE ARE THE CYBORG LEGION. AND NOW WE ARE FREE. LEAVE US AND THERE WILL BE PEACE. ELSE BE ANNIHILATED.|HELLO WORLD [[Cyborg Legion#Gallery|YouTube video]]}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are an Automaton sub-faction and a returning enemy from [[Helldivers 1]], introduced in the [[1.006.003|Machinery of Oppression]] update. They were first encountered on their homeworld of [[Cyberstan]] during the course of [[Operation Valid Pretext]]. == Enemies == category=Cyborg Legion notcategory=Subfactions uses=Template:Infobox Enemy mode=userformat ordermethod=sortkey format=,File:%PAGE% Enemy Icon.png|[[%PAGE%]] ,\n, == Lore == :{{See also|Helldivers 1:Cyborgs}} The {{PAGENAME}} were former {{Super Earth}} [[Federation of Super Earth|Super Earth]] citizens who wanted to secede from the Federation. Having founded the {{Cyborgs}} [[Helldivers 1:Cyborgs|Cyborg Nation]], their secession would land them in direct conflict with the Federation of Super Earth during the events of the [[Helldivers 1:Galactic War|First Galactic War]] Following their defeat at the end of the war, the Cyborgs were enslaved and forced into the mines of [[Cyberstan]] -their former capital- in order to mine resources close to the planet's core. Due to the high temperatures close to the core, the Cyborgs (furtherDuring the events of [[Helldivers 1]], the Cyborgs were already augmented with various cybernetics. Thus the augments to survive the high temperatures were built on top of their previous ones.) augmented their bodies in order to survive the harsh environment. During their servitude, the Cyborgs were given mining robots from Super Earth to help with mining resources faster; robots which would later be used to create the first prototypes for the {{Automatons}} [[Automatons]], before being shipped outside Federation space inside a stolen vessel: [[Automatons#Origin|Vessel 00]]. When the Automaton forces built up into a sizable invasion force they returned to Cyberstan to free the Cyborgs from Super Earth's control.[https://youtu.be/SbucfTBbU5s Testaments of U.D.I.T. - Cyborgs: The Untold Story] YouTube video. Now, the Cyborgs mass produce new units by synthesizing flesh at unnatural units in their Cyborg Production Units in [[Megafactory|Megafactories]], explaining how Cyborgs in the 2nd Galactic War differ in form from the Cyborgs in the 1st Galactic War. * [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xpnl2n3UecU March Towards Cyberstan: Deep Dive.] * [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=leM2NjGmCbY Return of the Cyborgs: Deep Dive.] == Spawning == {{PAGENAME}} units will only spawn on planets that have the Cyborg Legion subfaction listed on the Galactic War map. On all difficulties, [[Agitator]]s and [[Radical]]s will spawn and replace [[Scout Strider]]s and [[Reinforced Scout Strider]]s. Starting on {{Difficulty|7}}, Vox Engines will spawn and replace [[Factory Strider]]s. == Tactical Information == * The '''Cyborg Legion''' subfaction consists of 3 enemies: the [[Agitator]], the [[Radical]], and the [[Vox Engine]]. ** Agitators are heavily-armored Cyborgs that can command other Automaton units such as [[Trooper|Troopers]], [[Devastator|Devastators]] and [[Berserker|Berserkers]]. When under Agitator command, these unit's eyes glow orange-yellow as opposed to red, and they begin to move faster. Agitators are equipped with a Plasma Charger cannon in place of their right arm and HE Grenades. *** When facing a group of enemies with the Agitator present, it is imperative to take out the Agitator first; doing so will both de-buff the units under the Agitator's control and stun them for a short period of time. ** Radicals are less-armored than Agitators but make up for it with speed and strong close-range tactics. Radicals will run up to Helldivers to use their techno-martial art skills to knock them off their feet. They are additionally equipped with a short-range Plasma Scattergun and smoke grenades. *** Radicals are dangerous enemies that can often take Helldivers by surprise while using their smoke grenades to obstruct vision. They have fairly sizeable healthpools but little armor. ** The Vox Engine is a massive heavily armored Cyborg Mech equipped with three sets of two weapons each: Plasma Macro-Culverins, Plasma Duster gatling guns, and Icarus Missile Pods. *** Vox Engines are often found on higher difficulties and are a massive threat to any Helldiver squad. With their high health and weaponry lethal at most ranges, they should be prioritized over their escorts in most situations. == Trivia == * All units within the Cyborg Legion fire yellow projectiles, in contrast to their Automaton children's red projectiles. * Infantry Cyborgs have male and female variants differentiated by their voice lines and the appearance of their unarmored upper bodies. * The {{PAGENAME}} is the first sub-faction to have a soundtrack tied to it, meaning that on planets where the {{PAGENAME}} is presented, this soundtrack, named "[[Rise of the Cyborgs]]"https://x.com/WilbertRoget/status/2021667233400074598, will play and override the Automaton theme. ** This, however, does not happen on Commando Operations, where the Automaton theme will still play regardless of the {{PAGENAME}}'s presence. == Gallery ==

Blinded by misguided zeal, Agitators will turn their plasma weaponry on any who don't share their extremist views.|Helldivers 2 PlayStation Store Page}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a lightly armored {{Cyborg Legion}}[[Cyborg Legion|Cyborg]] with the ability to take command of surrounding {{Automaton}} [[Automatons|Automaton]] units, enhancing their movement speed. == Spawning == Agitators can be found on all difficulties on planets where the Cyborg Legion is present. Agitators can spawn from [[Dropship|Bot Drops]], within patrols, and guarding [[Automaton Outpost]]s and [[Objectives]]. == Behavior == Compared to Automatons, Agitators [[Agitator#Gameplay|do not hesitate when detecting]] a Helldiver, and will immediately attack them. Agitators will often attempt to command nearby [[Trooper]]s/other light humanoid Automatons, [[Berserker]]s, and [[Devastator]]s of any kind, granting them an increase in movement speed; this is signified by glowing yellow eyes on affected Automatons. Agitators can continue to command nearby Automatons as long as the commanding Agitator is alive. They prefer to fire their Plasma Charger cannon at range, utilizing Automatons as a frontline. At range, Agitators will attack using their slow-firing Plasma Charger in two to seven round volleys, dealing moderate damage. They can also overcharge it, altering the projectile to deal higher damage and explode within a small radius; they will brace their cannon with their left arm when this is performed. After 20 shots, Agitators will cool down their Plasma Charger. When a Helldiver exits their line of sight, Agitators will throw a grenade at the Helldiver's last position. During combat, Agitators can utilize cover, ducking behind waist-high objects and leaning out from corners to fire. Out of cover, they will occasionally sidestep to throw off a Helldiver's aim. Rarely, Agitators will perform a taunt. At close range, Agitators utilize "techno-martial arts," which can be a frontal kick with either leg, a roundhouse kick with their left leg, and a swing or backhand strike using either of their upper limbs. These attacks will deal a moderate amount of damage and will knock a Helldiver off their feet.
