The {{Appropriators}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are an {{Illuminate}} [[Illuminate]] sub-faction comprised of "pure" Illuminate. As such, they do not contain any Voteless and contain much more ground-based enemies.

== Overview ==
This subfaction is represented exclusively by the Illuminate and their machinery. [[Voteless]] and [[Fleshmob]]s are not present. Interestingly, [[Crescent Overseer]]s and [[Stingray]]s are also not present despite being Illuminate and Illuminate machinery respectively.

As such, heavier equipment is more favored, though it is possible to use high Rate of Fire weaponry to eliminate them.

== Enemies ==
<dpl>
  category=Appropriators
  notcategory=Subfactions
  uses=Template:Infobox Enemy
  mode=userformat
  ordermethod=sortkey
  format=<gallery>,File:%PAGE% Enemy Icon.png|link=[[%PAGE%]]|[[%PAGE%]] ,\n,</gallery>
</dpl>

== Lore ==
The {{Appropriators}} Appropriators were first detected on [[Seasse]], [[Major Order#A3-3-4|setting up]] [[Destroy Exospire|Exospires]]. Despite suffering casualties from the operation conducted by the Helldivers on the planet, the Appropriators managed to accomplish their task, engulfing the entire system in what Super Earth would later call [[The Void]].

Several hours after the creation of The Void, the Appropriators [[Major Order#A3-3-6|were spotted setting up additional Exospires]] on [[Hort]] while the {{Mindless Masses}} [[Mindless Masses]] launched an attack on [[Rirga Bay]] at the same time. This time, the '''Ritual Storm''' would be successfully stopped, though not without territorial loss. 

According to Super Earth High Command, their primary objective seems to be abducting as many humans as possible.<ref>[[Major Orders#A3-4-5]]: ''Appropriator squads—combat units dedicated to the illegal extraction of Federation personnel—are targeting the very heart of the human family, snatching hardworking voters from their idyllic porches for unconfirmed reasons formally designated as Undemocratic. ''</ref>

== Spawning ==
{{PAGENAME}} units will only spawn on planets that have the Appropriators subfaction listed on the Galactic War map.

== Tactical Information ==
* Since [[Voteless]] and [[Fleshmob]]s are absent in the Appropriators, Helldivers do not have to rely on high-rpm weaponry to eliminate them, and can rely on more anti-heavy equipment to complete the mission.
** Flamethrowers, such as the [[FLAM-40 Flamethrower]] and [[B/FLAM-80 Cremator]], can make quick work of the piloted mechs, as well as [[Harvester]]s, albeit with the risk of being struck by the Harvester's arc weapons.
** The [[LAS-98 Laser Cannon]] can deal sustained DPS from a distance, where many heavy units are less dangerous.
** All of these also make quick work of [[Overseer|Overseers]], but ammo economy may be an issue.
* Use of melee is not advised, as [[Obtruder|Obtruders]], the primary swarm enemy of the subfaction, may fly out of melee range, and have a tendency to explode upon death, potentially killing any Helldivers below.
* As Obtruders and Overseers are still prominent, at least one high-output weapon is advised to keep Helldivers from being completely overrun.
** The [[LAS-5 Scythe]] can hit plenty of Obtruders in a short period of time, setting them on fire, and can sometimes damage Overseers directly through their armor, while the [[LAS-16 Sickle]] can rapidly dispatch large groups of Obtruders due to its firerate and accuracy.
*** If overheat becomes a significant problem, the [[LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle]], when paired with [[Inflammable]] and [[Vitality Enhancement]], can sustain for much longer without needing to swap heat sinks.
** Assault rifles or SMGs with a high firerate, such as the [[AR-23A Liberator Carbine]], [[AR-61 Tenderizer]], [[MP-98 Knight]], or [[SMG-203 Gallant]] can deal enough damage to kill Overseers with enough firerate to hit groups of Obtruders and quickly eliminate them.
** Shotguns with high damage like the [[SG-97 Sweeper]], [[SG-20 Halt]] or any variant of the [[SG-8 Punisher|Punisher]] ([[SG-8S Slugger|Slugger]], [[SG-451 Cookout|Cookout]], or even the [[SG-8P Punisher Plasma|Punisher Plasma]]) can potentially one-shot Obtruders and kill Overseers in very few shots as well.
*** The Punisher Plasma may do less against Obtruders due to their explosive resistance, but it has the ability to stagger-lock groups of Overseers.
** In a pinch, Pistols like the [[P-19 Redeemer]] or [[P-92 Warrant]] can unleash high burst damage, with the latter's shots guaranteed to land.
** The [[LAS-58 Talon]] can often one-to-two-shot an Obtruder and kill an overseer with 5-6 shots to center mass or two shots to the head, although care should be taken to avoid overheating.
** The [[MG-43 Machine Gun]] can reliably kill any enemy in the subfaction, but will take your support weapon slot in the place of something more suited to heavy units.
* An even greater amount of damage than normal will be from explosions, thanks to Obtruders, Overseers, and Gatekeepers' ability to shoot plasma bolts at Helldivers.
** As such, armor with a resistance to explosive damage, such as [[Fortified]] or the [[CPR-80 Bulwark]], will significantly reduce incoming damage and improve survivability.

== Trivia ==
* The [[Veracitor]] is referred to as an "overly complicated forklift" by Super Earth High Command.
** In turn, the [[Gatekeeper]] is compared to "strapping guns to a forklift".
* When stunned, as by an [[Orbital EMS Strike]], the pilots of constructs can be seen banging on the controls in frustration, attempting to regain use of the mech.

The {{Vote Snatchers}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are an {{Illuminate}} [[Illuminate]] sub-faction comprised of mutated Illuminate creatures. 
== Overview ==
Mutated within [[the Void]], the Vote Snatchers subfaction is comprised of creatures similar in nature to [[Voteless]], mutated humans used to serve the Illuminates. The Vote Snatchers are said to have been "wrought into existence by the Illuminate".<ref>{{cite web  |url=https://blog.playstation.com/2026/08/12/helldivers-2-joins-playstation-plus-game-catalog-today-devoid-of-liberty-update-out-now/ |title=Helldivers 2 joins PlayStation Plus Game Catalog today, Devoid of Liberty update out now |date= 8-12-2026 |quote="...they are ghoulish diversions wrought into existence by the Illuminate scourge to threaten our freedom." |access-date=8-12-26.}}</ref> While on a planet occupied by Vote Snatchers, all [[Overseer]] variants, [[Harvester]]s, [[Watcher]]s, and [[Stingray]]s will be replaced by Crushers and Wretches.

== Spawning ==
* {{PAGENAME}} units will only spawn on planets that have the Vote Snatchers subfaction listed on the Galactic War map.
* Since there are no Watchers to call reinforcements, Vote Snatchers will only spawn naturally as patrols, and guarding points of interest.
** However they spawn in much greater numbers comparatively.
* On a planet occupied by Vote Snatchers, only [[Voteless]] and [[Fleshmob]]s will spawn alongside Vote Snatchers.

== Tactical Information ==
* The {{Vote Snatchers}}'''Vote Snatchers''' Sub-faction contain two unique enemies: the Wretch, and the Crusher. 
** Wretches are smaller, fast enemies that will pounce at Helldivers with razor sharp claws, somewhat mimicking the behavior of a [[Hunter]].
*** Unlike other enemies, destroying their head will not instantly kill them. In order to swiftly eliminate them, a limb or multiple must be destroyed before the head is considered a fatal hit.
*** When facing a group of wretches and Voteless, weapons with a high amount of DPS such as the [[MGX-42 Bullet Storm]] and [[MG-43 Machine Gun]] are highly effective at killing them.
*** Alternatively, crowd control options such as Fire or Gas weapons can disrupt Wretches, preventing them from closing the distance to Helldivers.
** The Crusher is a gigantic mutated creature equipped a massive club and heavily armored helmet. Outside of its helmet, its skin is very durable and requires heavy firepower to take down. Its helmet can be broken with {{Armor|4|AP}} armor penetrating weaponry, revealing its weak head. Attacks from its massive club can knock over or instantly kill Helldivers if hit directly.

The {{Mindless Masses}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are an {{Illuminate}} [[Illuminate]] sub-faction.

== Overview ==
This subfaction is represented by vast quantities of [[Voteless]] and [[Fleshmob]]s, with fewer deployed ''Squ'ith'' units. Reinforcement calls will not deploy [[Crescent Overseer]]s. [[Elevated Overseer]]s and [[Stingray]]s are absent from the battlefield.

== Lore ==
The {{Mindless Masses}} Mindless Masses first appeared on [[Heze Bay]] and [[Rirga Bay]] to slow down the Helldivers' push to [[Seasse]] as part of the operation to [[Major Order#A3-3-4|halt Illuminate operations on the planet]]. Despite their best attempts, the Mindless Masses were ultimately defeated by the Helldivers.

Several hours after [[The Void]] was created, the {{Mindless Masses}} Mindless Masses launched a series of attacks on Rirga Bay at the same time as the {{Appropriators}} [[Appropriators]] [[Major Orders#A3-3-6|began to raise]] [[Destroy Exospire|Exospires]] on [[Hort]]. One such attack ultimately overwhelmed Rirga Bay, shifting priorities to stemming the tide of Mindless Masses after the '''[[Exostorm|Ritual Storm]]''' on Hort had been taken care of.

Thereafter, Mindless Masses attacks from within and without the Void would remain a constant threat.

== Spawning ==
In missions where the Mindless Masses subfaction is presented, Helldivers will immediately notice an increase in [[Voteless]] spawns.  

On the lowest difficulties, roaming patrols of Voteless can easily have dozens of units in a single patrol, and swarms can quickly amass over 50 Voteless in seconds. [[Fleshmob]]s are more apparent as well at the appropriate difficulties, while [[Elevated Overseer]]s and [[Stingray]]s are completely absent.  

On lower difficulties, [[Watcher]]s are relatively rare in favor of Voteless swarms, meaning that the Illuminate often cannot summon reinforcements. In higher difficulties, the Voteless spawns seem to be a bit less overwhelming, while regular [[Overseer]]s and [[Harvester]]s will make themselves known, and Watchers resume spawning more typically. 

== Tactical Information ==

* Due to the increased amount of [[Voteless]] and [[Fleshmob]]s in place of other units, Helldivers will likely find themselves relying less on armor penetration and more on sheer damage to cut through some swarms of enemies. 
** The [[M-105 Stalwart]] and [[GL-21 Grenade Launcher]] can both rip through swaths of enemies while remaining mobile even when reloading.
** Flame weaponry such as the [[FLAM-40 Flamethrower]], [[B/FLAM-80 Cremator]], [[FLAM-66 Torcher]], and [[P-72 Crisper]] can ignite both the hordes and the ground beneath their feet, resulting in large crowds being burnt to a crisp. Helldivers should be mindful of flames splashing around and back towards themselves if the horde gets too close. 
** One-handed SMGs, Pistols, and the [[CB-9 Exploding Crossbow]] will allow the Helldiver to fire behind themselves while maintaining a jogging pace and staying out of melee range.
** Slower, more precise weapons such as Marksman Rifles and the [[APW-1 Anti-Materiel Rifle]] might leave a Helldiver overwhelmed in close quarters as they may struggle to quickly kill dozens of [[Voteless]] before they can get in melee distance.
** If one wishes to use AoE weapons to disperse the crowds of enemies, then weapons with a larger AoE, such as the [[GL-21 Grenade Launcher]] or [[EAT-411 Leveller]] should be considered compared to more direct Anti-Tank launchers, such as a [[LAS-99 Quasar Cannon]] or [[EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank]]
*** The [[RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher]] excels against this subfaction, being able to decimate entire patrols with a single round.
* Although Voteless and Fleshmobs are more predominant with this subfaction, heavier threats such as the [[Harvester]] can still appear, even frequently on higher difficulties. So while light armor penetration is often very useful on this front, a Helldiver squad should still consider having some armor-penetrating equipment and/or stratagems to engage heavier threats as needed.

As overkill damage can transfer through these heads, high alpha damage application to these head hit-zones can result in significant boosts in damage applied. This is most applicable on weapons such as the [[VG-70 Variable]] on TOTAL mode, where a single well-aimed salvo can "one-shot" the Fleshmob. ** When factoring the 25% durability and 150% damage multiplier of the Fleshmob's head flesh chunks, a Variable in TOTAL mode would deal 5,047 damage. * The Fleshmob is immune to flinching via gunfire and has an extremely high stagger resistance that cannot be matched by any loadout weapon. * Destroying all the Fleshmob's heads will not instantly kill it, but it does deal bonus damage to the main body, accelerating its death. ** The Fleshmob has incredibly high stun resistance. This resistance is pushed even further during its charge state; the only armaments that can stun a Fleshmob during this state are the [[Orbital EMS Strike]] and [[G-109 Urchin]]. *** Whilst not charging and with no SEAF asset within 15 meters, the Fleshmob can be stunned by the [[SG-20 Halt]] (Stun Ammo) and [[ARC-3 Arc Thrower]]. *** The [[G-109 Urchin]] grenade, when stuck on a Fleshmob, is able to interrupt a charge and stun it for almost the full grenade stun duration time; after the last grenade blast, the Fleshmob will continue its charge unless the Helldiver dives to the side to cancel it. * Breaking a Fleshmob's arms disables its swing attack, forcing it to resort strictly to charge attacks. ** Breaking its legs will not slow it down or disable its charge. * High-damage, explosive, and shrapnel weapons are the most effective at dealing with Fleshmobs. The {{Invasion Fleet}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Illuminate]] subfaction that is comprised of the regular Illuminate roster.

== Overview ==

== Lore ==
Following [[Federation of Super Earth|Super Earth's]] assault into [[The Void|the Void]] during [[Campaigns#Void Piercer|Operation:Void Piercer - Advancement]], [[The Helldivers|Helldivers]] would be assaulted by an increasingly desparate Illuminate, with them pushing more forces into the fight in the form of the {{Invasion Fleet}} Invasion Fleet.

This force, comprised of units of the [[The Great Host|Great Host]] that invaded Super Earth would join their fellow forces on multiple [[Void Sector|Void-engulfed planets]] in an attempt to repel SE forces. Their attempts would be unsuccesful, as the Helldivers were able to liberate the [[Void Source Planet]] formerly known as [[Seasse]], dispelling the Void and reverting any Illuminate-affected flora.

== Spawning ==
The Invasion Fleet will only appear on planets that already have a subfaction ([[Appropriators]], [[Mindless Masses]], [[Vote Snatchers]]) listed on the Galactic War map. It allows certain Illuminate units to spawn on planets with a subfaction that would have otherwise prevented them from spawning.

On Appropriators, the Invasion Fleet allows for [[Fleshmob|Fleshmobs]], [[Crescent Overseer|Crescent Overseers]], [[Stingray|Stingrays]], and [[Voteless]] to spawn.<!-- Needs confirmation -->

On Mindless Masses, the Invasion Fleet allows for Crescent Overseers and Stingrays to spawn.

On Vote Snatchers, the Invasion Fleet allows for Crescent Overseers, [[Elevated Overseer]]s, [[Harvester|Harvesters]], [[Overseer|Overseers]], Stingrays, [[Warp Ship]]s, and [[Watcher]]s to spawn.

== Tactical Information ==
* Helldivers must consider the increased enemy presence from the Invasion Fleet alongside the subfaction presented on the planet to craft a loadout that allows them to engage all possible threats.
** This is also applicable when considering the loadouts of squadmates as well. It is advised that different Helldivers separately bring Anti-Tank and chaff clearing [[Weapons#Support_Weapons|Support Weapons]].

== Trivia ==
* The Galactic Map description describes the subfaction as the "main invasion fleet," which suggests that these assembled enemies were originally part of the [[The Great Host|Great Host fleet]].
** Despite the description, the Great Host was comprised of the regular Illuminate roster, so this may be some flavor text that was used to describe the larger force descending on a planet.
* While the Invasion Fleet subfaction does not include any unique enemies, the ability for multiple subfactions to be on the same planet enabled for some interesting enemy compositions, creating more chaotic encounters.

{{Infobox Subfaction

{{Quote|Conventional SEAF forces are heavily deployed across the planet, and may directly support Helldiver missions.|Galactic War Table Description}}

'''Heavy SEAF Presence''' is a [[Effects|Modifier]] that allows SEAF squads to be deployed via [[Pelican Shuttle]]s to the mission area.

== Overview ==
The modifier was introduced as part of [[Campaigns#Void Piercer|Operation Void Piercer]]. On any planets where this modifier is active, SEAF soldiers will be deployed in missions via Pelican Shuttles.

Following [[Campaigns#Blazing Electorate|Blazing Electorate's]] failure on September 21st, 2026, {{PAGENAME}} was made unavailable. It was later added back on October 11th, 2026.<ref>"WARFRONT DEVELOPMENT - SEAF Battalions previously recalled to secure voting sites as detailed in the "Blazing Electorate" campaign are now returning to the frontlines. Trigger dicipline encouraged, democratic fervor mandatory." - Dispatch issued during [[Major Order#A3-10-3|Major Order A3-10-3]]</ref>

== Spawning ==
* Pelican Shuttles will periodically fly in to deploy up to 3 Squads of [[SEAF Soldier]]s to the mission area. Helldivers will know when this happens, as Mission Control will inform them.
** SEAF Squads are deployed on Helldivers fighting large amounts (estimated 20+) of enemies, or on enemy reinforcement call-ins. If neither is true, the SEAF Squads will remain in reserve.
** While there is a limit to the total active SEAF Squads deployed in a mission, there is no limit to the SEAF Squads in reserve. Pelican Shuttles will never run out of fresh SEAF Squads to deploy.

== Tactical Information==
* SEAF Soldiers deployed via this modifier always come in a general Squad composition consisting of 1 Squad Leader, 2 Riflemen, 2 Specialists, and 1 Medic. The SEAF Soldiers will follow their Squad Leader.
** For a proper description of these roles, please visit their [[SEAF Soldier|respective page]].
** Each deployed SEAF Soldier is always marked on the Helldivers mini-map with the small green dot.
* Each SEAF Soldier killed by direct actions of a Helldiver immediately deducts {{Currency|Requisition|25}} from the current amount for the [[Missions|Mission]]. This includes Soldiers killed by automated [[Stratagems]] such as the [[AX/AR-23 "Guard Dog"]] and [[A/G-16 Gatling Sentry]].
**The Pelican Shuttles that deploy the SEAF Soldiers often do so close to the Helldivers' position. As such, Helldivers should be aware of where they throw their Eagles, Orbitals, and Sentries to not kill the SEAF soldiers.
*** Pelican Shuttles will hold their descent if the area they are above is currently on fire or has any kind of offensive stratagem deployed. They will resume descending once the fire has dissipated or the offensive stratagem has ended.
** If a Helldiver is caught 9 times recklessly killing SEAF Soldiers or [[Civilian]]s, they will be branded as a traitor. As such, the [[Super Destroyer]] will begin firing [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage|380mm HE Shells]] at the Helldiver until they are killed. Mines will not add to the traitor tally but will still deduct Requisition Slips.
* The [[A/ARC-3 Tesla Tower]] does not react to SEAF Soldiers in its proximity. However, if an arc is triggered by someone else, it will still kill the SEAF Soldier.

== Trivia ==
* Although their default armor consists of the iconic light blue paint, save for the Medics, depending on the biome and super-structure, they will wear camo related to it.
** If they are on a Desert planet, such as a [[Desert Oasis]] biome like [[Fronteria]], they will be equipped with a desert-camo pattern.
* When SEAF squads were first added to the game, they are marked on the map as green dots, making them the first Ally NPCs to be identified on the map.
* Even when time has run out, Pelican Shuttles will keep spawning in and bring in fresh squads of SEAF Soldiers.

'''{{PAGENAME}}s''' are [[Federation of Super Earth|Super Earth]] transport shuttles used to move various cargo to and from a planetary surface. They are typically seen in Helldiver operations in various cargo missions, either deploying combat vehicles, or extracting fluids. A troop transport variant can also be found during missions, in the form of map wreckage.

==Lore/Technical Info==
Pelican shuttles come in three variants - Tanker, Cargo, and Troop Transport, though the third only appears as map wreckage. All are [[wikipedia:Tiltwing|tiltwing]] [[wikipedia:Single-stage-to-orbit|single-stage-to-orbit]] (SSTO) transport craft, and are restricted to [[wikipedia:VTOL|vertical take-off and landing (VTOL)]] exclusively due to the design of their landing gear.

=== Tanker Variant ===
Tanker Pelicans are unarmed and have an integrated fluid tank attached to the belly, with a built-in motorized extendable hose, enabling airborne fluid transfers. They maintain an altitude of at least a dozen meters during the fluid transfer before extracting.

'''List of Missions that Includes them:'''
* [[Conduct Mobile E-711 Extraction]]
* [[Enable E-710 Extraction]]
* [[Extract E-711]]
* [[Sabotage Orgo-Plasma Synthesis]]
* [[Confiscate Assets]]
* [[Rapid Acquisition]]

=== Cargo Variant ===
Cargo Pelicans are an armed variant that can deploy or extract various cargo to and from a planetary surface. Equipped with a nose-mounted Autocannon, it swivels around shooting any nearby enemy. Equipped with a pair of cargo clamps, each clamp is capable of adjusting angle and extension, and can extend past the sides of the shuttle to a significant degree, allowing them to easily pick up large and unusually-shaped cargo. The clamps in full are mounted on a rail system that allows them to move up and down the body of the aircraft to ensure balanced weight distribution. After dropping cargo or in the case of carrying objects that only require one clamp, the unused clamps fold up flat against the belly of the aircraft.

=== Troop Transport Variant ===
Troop Transport Pelicans, a Pelican variant that can be seen as map wreckage and dropping off [[SEAF Soldier|SEAF Soldiers.]] They are equipped with a passenger bay similar to that of the [[Extraction Shuttle]], though somewhat narrower and containing what appears to be a pair of lockers. Inside the passenger bay is a door leading to the cockpit, allowing it to be boarded that way rather than through the canopy as the other variants appear to require. As they are vehicles, albeit unusable ones, they can be marked as such as they deliver their payload.

== Trivia ==
* Although the Pelican shuttles' engines seem to be just jet engines, they are apparently capable of both atmospheric and vacuum operation, suggesting they are actually some type of advanced rocket engine, [[wikipedia:Combined_cycle_power_plant|combined-cycle engine]] (featuring both airbreathing and closed-cycle operation modes), or are [[wikipedia:Nuclear-powered_aircraft|nuclear thermal jets]]. Whatever engine type it may be, it must be incredibly efficient; the design of the shuttles suggests very little fuel volume (at least, very little fuel volume compared to what one would expect from a single-stage-to-orbit spacecraft).

pages.Atmospheric Interference:
{{Environmental Conditions|{{PAGENAME}}}} was an [[Operation_Modifiers|Operation Modifier]] in [[Helldivers 2]] exclusive to the [[Terminids|Terminid]] front. It reduced the accuracy of all [[:Category:Orbital Stratagems|Orbital Stratagems]] by adding a significant deviation to their trajectory.
== Details ==
Atmospheric Interference increases the spread of all Orbital Stratagem's trajectories. Without this modifier, Orbital Stratagems will always hit the location marked by the stratagem ball. With Atmospheric Interference, the actual target location will vary within a several meter radius around the beacon. Sustained barrages such as the [[Orbital Gatling Barrage]] and [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage]] will not correct themselves over time and continue to fire at wherever the barrage began.

== Strategy ==
Because all Orbital Stratagems become less accurate, they cannot be reliably used in combat. The worst affected is the [[Orbital Precision Strike|Precision Strike]] as it has the smallest margin of error of any Orbital with only a single shot and a relatively small area of effect, and using it against even the massive [[Bile Titan|Bile Titans]] with this modifier in play becomes a roll of the dice. Generally speaking, this modifier is less penalizing the wider an area that an Orbital affects.

The [[Orbital Laser]] and [[Orbital Railcannon Strike]] are only marginally affected by this modifier, as their initial target is subject to the same spread like all other orbitals. However, their ability to automatically track enemies is not affected, meaning that they see no real loss of performance.

As [[:Category:Hangar Stratagems|Eagle Stratagems]] remain unaffected by this modifier, they should be taken in the place of Orbitals where appropriate.

pages.Difficulty:
{{Breadcrumb Auto|parent=Game Mechanics}}
When selecting a [[Missions|Mission]] in [[Helldivers 2|''Helldivers 2'']] using the Galactic War console, a difficulty can be selected between level 1 {{Difficulty|1}} and level 10 {{Difficulty|10}}.

Each difficulty level offers a different set of missions. For example, some missions offered to the player on {{Difficulty|1}} are not offered on {{Difficulty|6}}. 

== Effects==
*The number of {{Currency|Medals}}, {{Currency|Requisition}}, and {{Currency|Experience}} you earn from a mission all depends on the difficulty you select. 
**Higher difficulty missions have increasing percentage multipliers for Requisition Slips and Experience, from +25% on {{Difficulty|3}} to +300% on {{Difficulty|10}}
**The Eradication Main Objective base-reward depends on the selected difficulty. Each difficulty affects the rewards by {{Currency|Experience|20|notext}} and {{Currency|Requisition|100|notext}}. E.g. {{Difficulty|6}} Eradication-mission rewards {{Currency|Experience|120|notext}} and {{Currency|Requisition|600|notext}}, and {{Difficulty|3}} rewards  {{Currency|Experience|60|notext}} and  {{Currency|Requisition|300|notext}}.
* Enemy forces are enhanced to increasingly lethal degrees.
**The number of enemies and the type of enemy both depend on the difficulty level set.
**The frequency of enemy patrol being [[Spawn Mechanics|spawned]] increases alongside the difficulty.
***In relation, the frequency of [[Democracy Space Station#Tactical Actions|DSS Eagle Strike]] and other tactical actions during missions decreases with increased difficulty.
*The number of [[Operation Modifiers]] present during the mission.
**One modifier is added on {{Difficulty|5}}.
**A second modifier is added on {{Difficulty|8}}.

* The number of Sub-Objectives required to complete a [[Main Objectives|Main Objective]] increases at higher difficulties.
* The number and size of enemy Outposts ([[Terminid Nest|Bug Nests]]/[[Automaton Outpost|Automaton Outposts]]/[[Illuminate Encampment|Illuminate Encampments]])
** Outpost spawning can vary quite drastically depending on a number of other factors as well, including biome, mission type, and [[Factions|faction]].

*The number of [[Optional Objectives]] increases at higher difficulties.
*Map size increases to accommodate the increased amount of Mission Objectives on the Expedition-mission. The size increase is lesser on the [[Super Earth Metropolis|Metropolis]] [[Biomes|biome]] maps.
**As difficulty increases once maximum map-size has been achieved, the Mission Objectives occupy spaces which otherwise might have had [[Minor Places of Interest]] being places upon.
*The number and type of {{Currency|Common||notext}} {{Currency|Rare||notext}} {{Currency|Super||notext}} [[Samples]] able to be found depends on the set difficulty.
**{{Currency|Common||notext}} Commons appear on all difficulties, while {{Currency|Rare||notext}} Rares first appear on {{Difficulty|4}}, and {{Currency|Super||notext}} Supers on {{Difficulty|6}} difficulty.
**The type of samples available during an operation can be confirmed on the Galactic War console when selecting an operation.

pages.Lava:
{{Infobox Hazard
| title=Lava
| image=Lava Lake.png
| description=Pools and rivers of molten lava, will ignite Helldivers upon contact
| type=Terrain
| locations= [[Magma Desert]], [[Automaton Megafactory]], [[Cyberstan Megafactory]]}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Environmental Hazards|Environmental Hazard]], found in abundance in [[Magma Desert]] planets, and occasionally in the form of concrete pits in [[Megafactory|Automaton Megafactory]] structures.

== Effect ==
* Anything coming into contact with lava will instantly ignite, dealing {{Damage|Fire|100 DPS|notext}} and constantly re-igniting entities until any contact with the lava ceases.
* Touching the lava will also deal a small amount of extra damage.

== Location ==
* Similarly to water on certain planets, lava can come in the form of lakes and seas, being found around the edges of mission areas and in large lakes separating large sections.
** Most of the time, these lakes will be large, requiring anything desiring to cross them to find an alternative route.
** Occasionally, {{Automaton}} [[Automaton|Automaton-built]] bridges can be found, allowing the lake to be crossed quickly and easily.
* Lava can also be found in the form of rivers, flowing across the surface and between crevices and rock formations.
** Rivers can easily be avoided by diving over them, as they are usually not very wide.
* Rarely, tiny lava pockets can be seen on the rocky surface of a planet, being on average not much bigger than a human.
* Occasionally, lava can be found in large concrete cutouts of the terrain on [[Megafactory]] structures.
** Tiny pockets on the surface may rarely also be seen.

== Tactical Information ==
* Walking over lava is not advised as the Helldiver will immediately be set on fire and take 100 damage per second, killing them in just around a second, depending on armor.
** As is standard for being set on fire, diving will immediately stop the fire. However when diving on lava, the Helldiver will be instantly re-ignited.
** The use of certain [[Armor]] with passives such as [[Inflammable]] and [[Acclimated]], and [[boosters]] such as the [[Vitality Enhancement]] booster can delay death by a few seconds.
* While vehicles can also cross over lava, usage of them on lava is also not advised, especially for longer periods of time.
** The [[M-102 Fast Reconnaissance Vehicle]] is not recommended  for crossing lava.
*** Once the FRV comes into contact with lava, the rubber tires will immediately catch on fire and explode, making any future steering extremely difficult.
*** The main body of the FRV will also catch on fire, exploding after about 10 seconds.
** Both the [[EXO-45 Patriot Exosuit]] and the [[EXO-49 Emancipator Exosuit]] can be used to cross  smaller patches of lava such as rivers, but this will damage the exosuit. its legs in particular.
* Anything landing on lava that comes inside a Hellpod, such as Helldivers, emplacements, turrets and [[Support weapon]]s will not catch on fire as they are protected by the Hellpod.
* Enemies such as the {{Automaton}} [[Automaton Legion]] cannot pathfind over lava, so if they happen to spawn on an island surrounded by lava with no way off of it, they will be unable to move.
** Stuck Automatons may still shoot back if they spot the Helldiver.

Lava Geysers are small to medium-sized bits of terrain, with a pocket of lava in the middle. These often explode, which is safe at a distance.

* Usually, these geysers are calm, being little more than a rock.

* After a few seconds of bubbling, the geyser will explode, spurting out lava and molten rocks, setting anything standing too close on fire and launching them away with a shockwave, which can sometimes prove deadly.

== Location ==
Lava geysers can be found on [[Magma Desert]]s on the ground, usually near streams of [[Lava]] and occasionally inside places of interest.

| image = Caustic Badlands Shrub.png

| type = Flora
| locations = All Biomes except Extreme Cold

'''Shrubs''', or '''Ferns''' depending on the [[Biomes|Biome]], are hindering plants of various shapes and colors.

== Effect ==

Both creatures and Helldivers become slower whilst walking through a Fern or Shrub. However, this is greatly negated for Helldivers when using the [[Muscle Enhancement]] [[Boosters|Booster]].

Additionally, when a Helldiver is crouching or prone inside of a Shrub, it reduces detection range from enemies, allowing enemy patrols to stroll right past a Helldiver. A black vignette surrounds the screen to confirm that you are concealed. Though, since hiding in a Fern or Shrub only hides a Helldiver visually, unsuppressed weapons and/or standing too close to the enemy can still alert them to your position.

== Location ==

Ferns and Shrubs can be found in any Biome excluding [[Extreme Cold]] biomes; specifically [[Boneyard]], [[Icy Glaciers]], and [[Moon]].

The {{Caustic Strain|text}} is an enemy sub-faction of acidic Terminids. The Caustic Strain is composed of [[Caustic Spitter]], [[Caustic Warrior]], [[Caustic Spewer]] and [[Caustic Charger]]s.

== Enemies ==

== Lore ==
{{Stub}}

== Spawning ==
On Caustic Strain-invaded planets, Caustic Warriors replace naturally spawning [[Warrior]]s in [[Minor Places of Interest|Places of Interest]], Mission Objectives, and patrols. Starting on {{Difficulty|6}}, Caustic Chargers replace [[Charger]]s. Starting on {{Difficulty|7}}, [[Charger Behemoth]] may replace Caustic Chargers.

== Behavior ==
Each of the Caustic Strain Terminids acts in a different way, but they all commonly explode upon death.

== Tactical Information ==
* Due to their bile explosion upon death, it is recommended for Helldivers to give themselves ample space between the target enemy and themselves.
** This makes close quarters weapons, such as the [[CQC-20 Breaching Hammer]], [[CQC-9 Defoliation Tool]], or any melee [[Secondary weapon]] poorly suited to the Caustic Strain.
** Weapons with high stagger or stun, such as the [[SG-451 Cookout]] or [[AR-32 Pacifier]] may help keep them at bay.
** [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]] and [[Tank (disambiguation)|Tanks]] can be particularly poorly matched as chaff enemies become landmines. Where Scavengers, Pouncers, and Warriors can be casually run over, Caustic Spitters and Caustic Warriors deal bonus damage to exosuits and tanks (1.5x and 3x respectively).
*The Caustic Strain is the only Terminid subfaction with access to a long range mortar-type attack through its Caustic Spewer. This may make long-range options such as the [[APW-1 Anti-Materiel Rifle]] or [[R-63 Diligence]] more attractive than usual on the Terminid front.
*The Caustic Charger is the only Terminid that can suddenly introduce low-visibility to a battlefield. On higher difficulties, Helldivers should expect their clouds to appear alongside any [[Bug Breach]].
**Due to worsened visibility, guided weapon options such as the [[P-92 Warrant]], [[P-33 Missile Pistol]], or [[FAF-14 Spear]] may be more useful.
**Targeted red stratagems, such as the [[Orbital Railcannon Strike]] or [[Eagle 110mm Rocket Pods]] can similarly remove an unseen Caustic Charger.

== Trivia ==
* The Caustic Strain was originally part of the regular Terminids before being split from the faction in the release of [[1.007.200|Devoid of Liberty: 7.2.0]].
** At the time of release, the Caustic Strain was not present on any planet, becoming the first announced subfaction to not be encountered right away.
** This change may have been part of a broader change to ease certain Major Order issues, such as targeting specific types of Spewers and Spitters. (i.e. a past few MOs related to killing these specific enemies)

{{IconPOI|Illuminate icon}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' was an [[Illuminate]] subfaction that attacked [[Super Earth]] using a massive fleet. It was whittled down, and eventually destroyed at the [[Super Earth/Battle Log|Battle of Super Earth]].

== Gameplay ==
=== Enemies ===
* The Great Host has no unique enemies, but introduced multiple:
** [[Crescent Overseer]]
** [[Fleshmob]]
** [[Illuminate Overship]] (mission-exclusive)
** [[Leviathan]]
** [[Stingray]]

These new enemies appear alongside standard Illuminate, and were added to their roster after the Battle of Super Earth.

=== Missions ===
The Great Host introduced two new missions:
* [[Repel Invasion Fleet]]
* [[Take Down Overship]]

Both missions are [[Metropolis|Mega-City exclusives]], with the Take Down Overship mission being added to the main Squid mission roster on Mega Cities.

== Lore ==
The Great Host was a massive Illuminate warfleet, presumed to have been built up in secret behind the veil of the [[Meridian Singularity]] over the 100 years since the end of the [[First Galactic War]]. 

After the [[Meridian Black Hole]] was stopped following the events of the [[Major Orders#A2-4-5|Major Order activating the Repulse Generator]], Super Earth believed the Illuminate to be completely defeated. In reality, their brief period of inactivity was preparing for a conventional invasion of Super Earth. With their arrival, Crescent Overseers, Fleshmobs, Stingrays, and Leviathans were all introduced as permanent additions to the Illuminate's roster.

=== Initial Contact ===
The arrival of the Great Host was first detected by [[Station-81]] and other Super Earth defense satellites. After exiting the Meridian wormhole, The Great Host launched an attack on [[Widow's Harbor]], followed by [[Pilen V]] and [[New Haven]], before finally reaching Super Earth itself. The ensuing battle spanned real life weeks over the course of 4 Major Orders. 

=== Defense of Super Earth ===
The assault began with High Command [[Major Orders#A2-5-2|informing Helldivers of the Great Host Fleet]], where Super Earth High Command quickly deduced that it would be impossible to preemptively stopping a force of such magnitude from reaching Super Earth. Nevertheless, Helldivers were ordered to whittle down The Great Host's fleet strength as much as possible while defenses were being prepared on Super Earth. The total strength of The Great Host fleet was measured as a percentage on Galactic War Tables across all [[Super Destroyer]]s. Footage of this initial attack was disseminated online by [[Major Truth]].

Several hours after the fall of New Haven, The Great Host razed Mars and began their invasion of Super Earth. By the time they had reached Super Earth, Helldiver forces had bled the fleet's strength by 21.5%. [[Major Orders#A2-5-3|Major Order to Defend Super Earth]] marked the beginning of the [[Galactic War/First Battle For Super Earth|Battle for Super Earth]], followed by the Orders to [[Major Orders#A2-5-4|continue the defense]] and [[Major Orders#A2-5-6|end the battle]]. 

As the battle went on, The Great Host was able to completely destroy the cities of [[Eagleopolis]], [[Remembrance]], [[Administrative Center 02]], [[York Supreme]], and [[Port Mercy]]. During the siege of [[Prosperity City]], the President of Super Earth was killed in action by The Great Host's forces. 

After weeks of fighting, a devastating cyberattack launched from [[Fort Union]], and a collective defense of Equality-On-Sea and Prosperity City, the fleet´s strength was fully depleted, and the Great Host was forced to retreat.

=== Aftermath ===
Following their loss at Super Earth, the remnants of the Great Host activated their cloaking measures and fled into an unknown part of the galaxy. Super Earth scientists, using Illuminate wreckage, managed to decipher the Illuminate cloaking methods, and were able to [[Major Orders#A2-6-2|track down the remnants]] of the Great Host.

Despite the Helldivers' best efforts, these remnants were not annihilated, and now occupy a section of the southern part of the known Galaxy.

== Tactical Information ==
* The Great Host enemies fill certain niches within the Illuminate roster, threatening Helldivers with dangers from heavies, long-range attacks, and aerial strafing runs.
** Similarly to other Illuminate enemies, Helldivers must keep moving to prevent being targeted and killed.
* Fleshmobs
** Fleshmobs are massive lumbering tanks that will charge Helldivers in unstoppable attacks. Prioritizing them ensures that Helldivers will not get charged and crushed when they turn and thrash their arms around.
** High DPS weaponry are ideal in eliminating them despite being vulnerable to all attacks. [[AC-8 Autocannon|AC-8 Autocannon flak rounds]] or [[StA-X3 W.A.S.P. Launcher|StA-X3 W.A.S.P. Launcher micro-missiles]] are also highly effective at killing them.
* Crescent Overseers
** These Overseers use long-ranged attacks via plasma mortar shots, and will only engage Helldivers at a distance. Finding them and eliminating them is highly encouraged.
** Helldivers should be cautious as they are capable of more direct-fire approaches, with them angling their weapon downwards to shoot at Helldivers.
** Due to their slower movement speed, they are incapable of quickly repositioning if you get close to them.
* Illuminate Overship
** These cannot be destroyed by Helldiver small arms fire or stratagems. They can only be destroyed by the Super Earth Orbital Defense Cannon.
** The Overship's shield can be destroyed by small arms, allowing Helldivers to lower the amount of rounds needed to destroy it.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Sandy type [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]].

== Description ==
{{Quote|Dense, toxic fumes from deep within the planet's crust seep out of cracks in the earth and coat the ground in a sickly haze.}}

The Acidic Badlands is similar to the [[Rocky Canyons]] biome, but foggier, hazier, and more acidic. It's terrain is mostly rocky, sandy, and hill-based, but it also features flatter areas, and occasionally a set of misty springs. Most noticeable are the mega rock formations, being taller than most buildings, from them, thick yellow mist falls, being heavier than the air itself.

Between the rocks and the sand, patches of tall grass grows, along with the unique harmless acid flower, it's faint glow seen even through the haze. In the sand itself, occasional purple blades of grass grow.

=== Surface Variations ===
==== Metropolises ====
In parks located in [[Metropolis]]es, the usual sandy terrain can be found. Although the biome seemingly has no trees, trees usually seen in Primordial biomes ''(such as the [[Volcanic Jungle]])'' will generate, having green leaves in this biome.

Green muddy terrain can rarely be found in park structures.

==== Megafactories ====
In the exterior of [[Megafactory|Megafactories]], the sandy terrain will be mostly flattened, with small hills and dunes. Smaller rock formations are still present, though any colossal rock formations are completely absent. Slowing Ferns and Acid Flowers can still occasionally be found.

The same applies to the interior of Megafactories, with the exception of Slowing Ferns and Acid Flowers generating.

==== The Gloom ====
The biome's color already resembles the color of [[The Gloom]] itself, though it is noticeably much more yellow, as opposed to the biome usual yellow-green color. The night skies still feature the bright orange Gloom spores from space, reflecting light back down onto the planet itself.

The Gloom also disables all environmental conditions on this biome.

==== Exostorms ====
On Acidic Badlands planets that harbor an [[Exostorm]], the dense green fog will dissipate slightly, becoming a distant light purple fog. The purple streaks that have been radiated from the planet into orbit can be seen from the ground between the clouds both during daytime and nighttime. Notably though, the Acid Storms environmental condition isn't present whatsoever, and is instead replaced by a constant effectless rain.

== Environmental Conditions ==
*{{Environmental Conditions|Acid Storms}}

== Environmental Hazards ==
* Thin fog clings to the ground
* Occasional water/acid springs, harmless, though they slow down any Helldivers deciding to take a bath
* [[Fern|Slowing Ferns]] are often present near rock formations

== Weather ==
* Clear
** The sky is mostly covered by clouds, though any stars, planets or otherwise background objects can still clearly be seen through the holes in the clouds.
[[File:Acidic Badlands Weather Clear.png|frameless]]

* Acid Storm
** The sky remains the same as during Clear weather, though the fog gains a greener tint. Acid droplets begin falling and splatter against a Helldiver's camera.
[[File:Acidic Badlands Weather Acid Storm.png|frameless]]

pages.Automaton Megafactory:
{{DisambigMsg|the Automaton Megafactories|the planet regions system|Regions}}
{{Infobox Biome
 | biome=Automaton Megafactory
 | landscape= Megafactory Landscape Header.png
 | caption_landscape=
 | internal_name = no_name
 | archetype = Megastructure
 | subvariant = Urban Megastructures
}}

'''Megafactories''' are a type of megastructure, unique to [[Regions]] that are found on some planets. They are exclusively found on planets {{Automaton}} [[Automaton]] control, and produce the {{Cyborg Legion}} [[Cyborg Legion]].

== Overview ==
Megafactories, unlike Super Earth [[Metropolis]]es, do not cover the entire mission area. They leave a section (about 20-30% of the mission area) as the original planet's biome. These exterior portions usually contain the [[Extraction Zone]], and have a chance to spawn a handful of [[Automaton Outpost|Outposts]] and the occasional [[Optional Objectives|Optional Objective]], such as [[Upload Escape Pod Data|Upload Escape Pod Data.]] The terrain inside the Megafactories also remains relatively as it was, excluding mountains, large rock formations, and any kind of ravine.

Inside the Megafactories stand tall, brutalist industrial buildings and machinery which occasionally have entry points, allowing both Helldivers and Automaton units to walk through them. Enemy [[Automaton Outpost|Outposts]] are constantly found here alongside enemy [[Optional Objectives]]. Monuments to the {{Cyborg Legion}} [[Cyborg Legion]] can also be found.

The Automaton/Cyborg language is printed on most of the large factory buildings. Smaller prints, such as signs, display sentences ''(for translations see this page's gallery, or [[Automatons#Propaganda]])''. Larger prints, either on the sides of buildings or along pipes, display numbers.

Between the Megafactory and the normal rural area stands a large, thick wall, separating them from each other with only a few access points, marked by icons on the map:
* '''Culverts:''' Occasionally along the wall, the terrain will suddenly dip lower to reveal a large culvert with a broken grate.
* '''Broken Walls:''' Some segments of the wall are destroyed, creating an opening into the Megafactory.
* '''Gates:''' Massive gates are commonly found across the wall. Though they are closed from the start, they can be destroyed by dealing enough damage to them.
** Automaton units can also open and close the gate itself when they get close.
<gallery mode="nolines">
File:MegafactoryGate.png|Map icon for a gate.
File:MegafactoryExit.png|Map icon for a culvert or broken wall.
</gallery>

== Gates ==
{{Anatomy Table|
  {{Anatomy Row
    | part_name = Gate
    | health = 6,000
    | av = 4
    | front_image = Anatomy Placeholder.png
    | side_image = 
    | durability = 800%
    | percent_to_main = -
    | bleed = None
    | fatal = Yes
    | exdr = 0%
	| df = 40
  }}
|df= yes
}}

== Environmental Hazards ==

Outside the Megafactory wall, a planet may retain its biome's environmental hazards; for those, see the planet's biome page. This section is about hazards found in every Megafactory regardless of biome.

* Large concrete cutouts full of [[Lava]] can be found across the surface. Stepping on them will deal damage and set the Helldiver on {{Damage|Fire}}.
* Occasional spills of {{Damage|Acid}} can be found on the ground. Stepping on them will deal damage over time.
* Tar slicks occasionally cover the floor near structures, particularly around Lava pools. Stepping on them slows down Helldivers and enemies.
* Ventilation systems that release steam can be found across most buildings. Staying near them upon steam release will deal minor damage and knock Helldiver down.

== Tactical Information ==
* Due to the limited entrances to the Megafactory, caution must be taken to ensure Helldivers are able to escape outside of them if the number of enemies starts overrunning their position.
** These entrances are relatively small, making them excellent chokepoints to eliminate enemies. Be aware that heavier enemies ([[Factory Strider]]s, [[Vox Engine]]s, etc) are able to pass through them as well.
* Due to the relatively open nature of the terrain, especially compared to Metropolises, Helldivers must be aware of their surroundings or risk being flanked by enemies.
** These are even more dangerous with close combat enemies, such as Agitators, Berserkers, and Radicals.
* The use of offensive stratagems is highly advised, though the increased presence of Anti-Air defenses means that Eagle Stratagems may be affected. Helldivers are advised to seek and destroy them whenever possible, even if they do not use Eagle Stratagems.
* Gate entrances can either be destroyed or opened by Automatons. A slow, but simple way to open them is to fire into the air and bait them into opening it.
** Gates can also be destroyed with force using [[Demolition]] '''40''' [[Throwable|Throwables]] like the [[G-48 Giga Grenade]] or [[Stratagems]] such as an [[Eagle Airstrike]].
** Finding an alternative entrance/exit (through a culvert or a broken wall) is more advisable and efficient.


==Trivia==
*Megafactory Gates are the only entities in the game to have a durability value higher than 100%.
**Due to this, weapons with a durable damage ratio of '''87.50% or lower''' deal '''zero''' '''damage''' to the gate. Weapons with a durable damage ratio of '''100%''' do '''full damage''' and weapons with a durable damage ratio '''higher than 100%''' deal '''bonus damage'''.
*The track: [[Rise of the Cyborgs]], the theme of the {{Cyborg Legion}} [[Cyborg Legion]], will always play in Megafactory regardless if the Cyborg Legion is present or not.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Forest [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]].

== Description ==
Similarly to the [[Deciduous Forest]], the Autumn Forest is a lush biome that features mostly flat terrain covered by multicolored grass usually in the warm color range (red, orange, yellow). Along the grass, flowers, and ferns, thickets of trees with autumn colored leaves can be found covering most of the surface, with some orange pine trees occasionally being found. Rocks and rocky hills are present all across the surface, as well as shin-deep lakes and rivers, posing little to no threat to a Helldiver looking to take a swim.

Due to the constant autumn state of this biome, as well as the potentially billions of trees on a single planet, large, maple leaves will be constantly floating around in the air.

The skies and atmosphere are colored blue, with the skies turning a yellow/orange color for the sunset, and a dark blue color at night with the stars and the nearby celestial objects being visible. The clouds are also very puffy and unlike on most other biomes, they take on a nearly fully white color. Unlike on most other biomes, nighttime is usually bright and the visibility is good.

As for fauna, distant insect chirps can be heard at all times, either during the day, at night, or during total eclipses.

=== Surface Variations ===
==== Exostorms ====
On Autumn Forest planets that harbor an [[Exostorm]], distant fog will appear and the skies will become noticeably more hazy. During an Exostorm, rain will endlessly fall from the sky, aided by some lightning.

The purple streaks that have been radiated from the planet into orbit can be seen from the ground between the clouds both during daytime and nighttime and occasionally "blink", giving the surface a more purple color before dimming.

== Environmental Conditions ==
This biome features no Environmental Conditions.

== Environmental Hazards ==
Slowing [[Fern]]s, which slow any Helldiver passing through them down.

== Weather ==
* Clear
** The skies are filled by either small amounts of large, white puffy clouds, or thin, veil-like clouds. Fog is minimal.
[[File:Sangis Planet Landscape Header.png|frameless]]

* Rain / Sunshower
** Rainy weather will always begin with light wind and a sunshower, with the sky only being covered by grey clouds soon after. This weather also features thickened fog.
[[File:Autumn Forest Weather Rain.png|frameless]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Swamp type biome that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]].

== Description ==
{{Quote|Tall, gnarled trees flourish across the surface of this forested world. Sunlight filters past dangling vines, to the saturated undergrowth below.}}

The Basic Swamp is a lush biome known for its massive trees and thick roots.

The surface of the Basic Swamp biome is very hill-like and uneven, going up and down. It is filled with grass, tall grass, flowers, roots and massive thick trees. Sometimes, trees can become so large and so thick, they can create a massive barrier made of bark that can only be walked around, not through.

The surface is also filled with water, with massive deep rivers/lakes dividing entire mission areas. As the biome is swampy, shin-deep green stagnant water can also be found across the surface, with both roots, trees, rocks, roots, and grass occasionally coming out of the waters.

As for the skies, almost 50% of it is filled by both thin and puffy white clouds at all times. The background of the planet also features very tall distant rocky towers with trees at the very top.

=== Surface Variations ===
==== Metropolises ====
In parks located in [[Metropolis]]es, the usual grassy terrain can be found. Although the biome has massive trees in wilderness areas, Earth-like trees will generate with green leaves in this biome.

The massive background terrain spires are also still in Metropolises, being seen in the backdrop when standing near the edge of a city.

==== The Gloom ====
Inside [[The Gloom]], the planet loses its main environmental condition [[Rainstorms]]. The atmosphere and the clouds become fully puffy and noticeably more yellow than usual as a yellow/orange fog permanently appears in the distance. The murky waters also reflect the now-yellowed skies, becoming a yellow color.

==== Exostorms ====
On Basic Swamp planets that harbor an [[Exostorm]], the planet's present fog will turn a slight shade of pink, which turns into an indigo shade at night. It will also permanently rain thanks to the [[Rainstorms]] modifier.

== Environmental Conditions ==
{{Environmental Conditions|Rainstorms}}

== Environmental Hazards ==
* [[Volcano Plant|Volcano Plants]] explode into fire when damaged.
* [[Fern|Tall Grass and Ferns]] slowing any Helldivers walking through it down.
* Deep water that causes any Helldiver taking a swim to drown, along with large rivers that often cut through the mission area.

== Weather ==
* Clear
** Clear weather represents the main weather state of the Basic Swamps, with the skies filled by both large, puffy clouds and thin, veil-like clouds, covering about 50% of the sky.
[[File:Basic Swamp Sky Clear.png|frameless]]

* Light Rain
** Occasionally, light sunshowers can occur.
[[File:Barbados_Day_Wilderness_Light_Rain.mp4|frameless]]

* [[Rainstorms]]
** When the Rainstorms effect is active, the skies will be fully covered by thick grey clouds with large amounts of droplets falling as heavy rain sets in.
[[File:Barbados_Day_Wilderness_Rainstorm.mp4||frameless]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an Oasis [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on one planet in [[Helldivers 2]].

== Description ==
The Bleak Oasis, similarly to its [[Desert Oasis|less "alien" couterpart]], is an arid biome featuring dunes made from a grey-colored sand, and features the occasional bleak grey grass patches. Tall palm trees with grey drooping leaves can also be found commonly across the surface of the Bleak Oasis, alongside grey colorless ferns. Large natural rocks can also be found everywhere, covered in the grey sand that fills the biome.

The surface also features knee-deep lakes of stale grey, also coming in the form of massive lakes and rivers that cross the mission area. The skies are usually grey and bleak, taking on a slightly darker tone at night. The most notable feature is a massive sun which seems to always be eclipsed by an object with a small pinhole in its center. It is not known whether that object is a planet, a moon, a [[wikipedia:Dyson sphere|Dyson Sphere]], or something else.

Visually, Bleak Oasis planets seem to be inspired by a mixture of both the dunes of the Sahara Desert and the lush patches found in the California Desert, mixed in with the colors and overall feeling of the [[Deadlands]].

== Environmental Conditions ==
This biome has no Environmental Conditions.

== Environmental Hazards ==
* Slowing [[Fern]]s, which slow any Helldiver passing through them down.
* Even though most of the water found is either shin- or knee-deep, occasional deep pits of water can still be found (especially on explosion sites), which can drown a careless Helldiver.

== Weather ==
This biome features no differentiating weather.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an Arctic type [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]].

== Description ==
{{Quote|Ice and moss-covered rock can be found across most of the surface of this planet.}}

The Boneyard has a surface made up of mostly rock, as cliffs and jagged rock formations fill the surface. Most of the surface is covered by a thin sheet of snow, covering everything from rocks, buildings, outposts, Helldivers, weapons, etc. Boneyards also feature lakes and seas on it's surface, often dividing mission areas.

Most notably, the surface is filled with large bones, most of which are ribcages. As for flora, no trees are present, only the occasional shrub and flower being found on the surface. The ground also occasionally has patches of brown/orange grass

The skies are usually cloudy with a dark and grey coloring, and it's atmosphere often turns green during sunrise and sunset.

=== Surface Variations ===
==== Individual Variants ====
Two variants exist for this biome, each exclusive to a singular planet:

* [[Tien Kwan]], which features no topographical changes to the surface or any of it's atmosphere, other than the presence of an extra [[Meteor Storms]] environmental condition and the color of the fog, which is greenish-grey.

* The [[Cyberstan Megafactory]], a variant unique to [[Cyberstan]] with little to no water, massive manufacturing districts, and an extremely polluted atmosphere. This variant does not generate any bones or otherwise any osseous structures.

==== Metropolises ====
In parks located in [[Metropolis]]es, the usual snow/rocky terrain can be found. Although the biome seemingly has no trees, pine trees covered in snow can be found.

Any rock formations, including the colossal rocks are completely missing. Slowing Ferns and Frost Flowers are also missing.

==== Megafactories ====
In the exterior of [[Megafactory|Megafactories]], the terrain will be mostly flattened and covered in snow, with small hills and dunes as well as small ravines. Smaller rock formations are still present, though any colossal rock formations are completely absent. Slowing Ferns and Frost Flowers can still occasionally be found near rock formations. The biome's usual bones and osseous structures can't be found anywhere.

Inside Megafactories, the terrain becomes mostly rocky and the rare orange grass/leaves become more present, while the snow becomes rarer and scarce. Slowing Ferns and Frost Flowers don't generate within Megafactories whatsoever.

==== The Gloom ====
Within [[The Gloom]], the Boneyard will receive a yellow coloration of the Atmosphere, and the clouds will gain an orange shade. The water will also refract the new yellow color of the planet. The Gloom is especially pronounced thanks to the snow present on the planet.

== Environmental Conditions ==
*{{Environmental Conditions|Extreme Cold}}
** Due to the cold conditions of the Boneyard, a Helldiver's screen will visually freeze near the edges and corners.

== Environmental Hazards ==
* [[Frost Flower|Frost Flowers]] that will produce a mist that slows any Helldiver inside if damaged.
* Deep water, where if the Helldiver decides to take a swim and does not leave the water in time, they will drown.

== Weather ==
* Light Overcast
** About 50% of the sky is covered by clouds, though any stars, planets or otherwise background objects can still clearly be seen through the holes in the clouds.
[[File:Boneyard Sky Light Overcast Night.png|frameless]]

* Overcast
** The skies are mostly covered by clouds, though any stars, planets or otherwise background objects can still be seen through the holes in the clouds.
[[File:Boneyard Sky Overcast Night.png|frameless]]

'''Colonies''' are a unique biome megastructure found on various planets. Due to their sheer size, colonies can be considered a sub variant of their respective biome.

== Overview ==
Colonies are large, randomized, grid based biomes. Their network of streets help connect a variety of different buildings, parks, and monuments. On missions where a colony spawns, at least one objective, such an an enemy encampment, sub objective, or main objective, will be found inside a colony.

Colonies appear different based on the presiding faction:
* [[Illuminate]] occupation leaves the colonies themselves largely untouched, save for the occasional structure or makeshift camp containing parked [[Warp Ship]]s.
* [[Automaton]] occupation leaves buildings razed, covering the streets in soot and debris. Automaton iconography, red light fixtures, and [[Bulk Fabricator]] outposts reaffirm their control over the colony. 
* [[Terminid]] infestation pervades every crevice of a colony. Roads are overgrown and structures are covered in Terminid nesting material. Large holes have been dug into the ground and the sides of buildings to form [[Bug Nest]]s.

The perimeter of every city is guarded by a thick, destructible wall, occasionally interrupted by [[Checkpoint]] structures. These walls may be destroyed by [[Demolition]] Force 40 attacks, such as the [[Eagle Airstrike]] and [[Orbital Precision Strike]].

== Tactical Information ==
Colonies offer predictable geometry and sightlines, but often forces combat encounters to stay in the close to mid range. If a substantial amount of the mission will take place in a colony, it can be important to plan one's loadout accordingly.
* [[FRV|FRVs]] can naturally generate inside Colonies, often spawning at [[SEAF SAM Site]]s, [[SEAF Artillery]], or [[Cognitive Disruptor|Cognitive Disruptors]].
* Their many unique structures and [[Minor Place of Interest|Minor Places of Interest]]s tend to store generous amounts of ammo, grenades, stims, and other supplies.

== Structures ==
Certain structures generate within a colony, some being faction-specific. 

==== Super Earth Structures====
* [[SEAF SAM Site]]
** In colonies occupied by the [[Illuminate]], SEAF SAM sites will spawn following the colony layout (if spawns in the colonies).  
** By contrast, in colonies occupied by [[Automatons]], SEAF SAM sites do not necessarily spawn according to the colony layout.
* [[Launch ICBM|ICBM Launch Site]]
* [[SEAF Artillery]]
* [[Evacuate Colonists|Evacuation Facility]]
* [[Emergency Evacuation|Evacuation Broadcast Towers]]
* [[Enable Oil Extraction|Oil Storage Plant]]
* [[Free Colony|Flag Pole]]
* [[Retrieve Recon Craft Intel|SEAF Bomber Crashsite]]
* [[Retrieve Recon Craft Intel|Data Uplink Tower]]

==== Automaton Structures ====
* [[Anti-Air Emplacement]]
* [[Automaton Outpost]]
* [[Bulk Fabricator]]
* [[Detector Tower]]
* [[Mortar Emplacement]]
* [[Stratagem Jammer]]
* [[Orbital Cannons]]

==== Illuminate Structures ====
* [[Illuminate Encampment]]
* [[Monolith]]
* [[Cognitive Disruptor]]

==== Terminid Structures ====
* [[Spore Spewer]]

These old Colonies, unlike the official Automaton Colonies, were almost completely undamaged. The middle of the colony would be fully replaced by flat terrain and generate Automaton structures as part of the mission objective.
* On colonies exclusively found on [[Boneyard]] and [[Icy Glaciers]] biomes, most surfaces will at least be somewhat covered by a thin sheet of snow.

This biome is a variant of the [[Boneyard]] biome. The surface of Cyberstan is very rocky, often featuring large rock formations and valleys. The surface is also almost completely covered with snow, and small ice spikes can occasionally be found. Sometimes, patches of dirt will be visible through the snow, revealing brown, possibly dead grass. The space above is still visible during the night, including the planets orbiting Cyberstan's local system, but they are blocked out by the thick smog most of the time. Like the [[Super Earth Metropolis]] biome generating [[Metropolis]]es, every map will be generated with an [[Automaton Megafactory]] covering 60-70% of the mission area. The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Primordial type [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]].

== Description ==
{{Quote|The lifeless grey of this planet is interrupted only by the violet flowers that grow from strange, parasitic outcroppings.}}

Like the other primordial biomes, the Deadlands feature dense jungles full of plants and ferns, all of them being ash-colored mixed with light shades of purple. Unlike the other primordials, the Deadlands feature trees with drooping grey leaves. Large clearings also fill the surface, full of ash-grey grass, purple flowers and rock formations. The planet also features beaches, oceans, the occasional lake, and distant mountain ranges.

The skies are usually grey colored with a thick grey fog filling the air. On some planets, the skies and the fog can turn a red color thanks to a nearby red gas giant planet.

=== Surface Variations ===
==== Metropoli ====
[[Metropolis|Metropoli]] within the Deadlands generate green earthly terrain with the biome's usual grey grass blades. Earth-like trees with green-grayish leaves will also be found in certain parks alongside purple and pink ferns.

Metropoli will also be extremely foggy, as the biome usually is.

==== The Gloom ====
Within [[The Gloom]] thanks to the biome's neutral white/grey color, the atmosphere and the fog becomes significantly more yellow than usual, reflecting onto the water and turning it into a yellow color as well. The ground and foliage itself don't change color, however they end up also looking yellow thanks to the atmosphere. Changes incited by the Gloom are much more noticeable at night.

== Environmental Conditions ==
{{Environmental Conditions|Thick Fog}}

== Environmental Hazards ==
* The deadlands feature [[Spike Plant]]s and [[Lava Pits]].
* The deadlands also have a hidden trait; [[Damaged Hellbomb|unmarked Damaged Hellbombs]] may appear in any difficulty. In any other biome, this feature is limited to {{Difficulty|4}} and above.

== Weather ==
* Foggy
** Foggy weather is the only weather for the deadlands, featuring thick heavy fog that hides nearly everything past 200 meters.

[[File:Pandion-XXIV Planet Landscape Header.png|frameless]]

{{Infobox Biome | biome = Deciduous Forest | landscape = Deciduous Grove Biome Header.png | caption_landscape = | description = No description given. | internal_name = deciduous_base | archetype = Forest | armor_camo = Forest }} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Forest [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]]. == Description == The Deciduous Forest is a lush biome that features mostly flat terrain covered by green grass and multi-colored flower patches. The surface is also mostly covered by thickets of trees, with some rarely being pine trees. The surface also contains some large rocky mountainous formations, found rarely between the trees. Another feature are the lakes and rivers on the surface, though these feature shin-deep water that poses little to no threat to a Helldiver looking to take a swim. The skies and atmosphere are colored blue, with the skies turning a yellow/orange color for the sunset, and a dark blue color at night with the stars and the nearby celestial objects being visible. The clouds are also very puffy and unlike on most other biomes, they take on a nearly fully white color. Unlike on most other biomes, nighttime is usually bright and the visibility is good. As for fauna, butterflies can be seen floating around the surface, as well as a call from a ''potentially'' Avian creature occasionally being able to be heard. Flocks of black birds can also be seen flying around after a tree is destroyed. All Deciduous Forest planets have an unusually fast rotation speed, making it possible for an entire day to go through during a single mission.{{citation needed|Prove It.}} Of all the biomes available, the Deciduous Forest is by far the most Earth-similar biome. == Environmental Conditions == This biome features no Environmental Conditions. == Environmental Hazards == Slowing [[Fern]]s, which slow any Helldiver passing through them down. == Weather == * Clear ** The skies are filled by either small amounts of large, white puffy clouds, or thin, veil-like clouds. Fog is minimal. [[File:Deciduous Forest Weather Clear.png|frameless]] * Rain / Sunshower ** Rainy weather will always begin with light wind and a sunshower, with the sky only being covered by grey clouds soon after. The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Sandy type [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]].

== Description ==
{{Quote|A desert planet prone to unpredictable and dangerous sand twisters.}}
The Desert Cliffs biome is composed of rocky and sandy terrain, more often than not being very hilly, however, it still features flatter areas and occasionally a set of misty springs. Large rocks cover the surface, dividing parts of the map and providing cover. In between the rocks and the sand, sometimes tall, dead shrubs can be found.

=== Surface Variations ===
==== Atmosphere ====
Depending on atmospheric composition and outside factors like the color of the system's star, the overall color of the planet's atmosphere may change. This may be seen when selecting the planet on the galactic map, where the glowing outline of planet's hologram turns into its atmosphere's respective color.

* '''Blue:''' Planets like [[Erata Prime]] have a normal blue atmosphere, similarly to deserts found on Earth.
* '''Orange:''' Planets like [[Polaris Prime]] have an orange atmosphere, changing the sky color and makes the orange sand much more vibrant.

==== Metropolises ====
In parks located in [[Metropolis]]es, the usual sandy terrain can be found. Although the biome seemingly has no trees, trees usually seen in Primordial biomes ''(such as the [[Volcanic Jungle]])'' will generate, having green leaves in this biome.

==== The Gloom ====
[[The Gloom]] changes the skies into a much more noticeable yellow. The night skies still feature the bright orange Gloom spores from space, reflecting light back down onto the planet itself and giving it a more green night color.

Unlike on most biomes, The Gloom does not disable any environmental conditions.

==== Exostorms ====
On Desert Cliffs planets that harbor an [[Exostorm]], distant fog will appear and the skies will become dustier. As the Exostorm lifts sand into the air, the surface will become darker for each Exostorm Class until daytime looks like dusk. Notably though, the Tremors and Intense Heat environmental conditions aren't present whatsoever, and are instead replaced by a constant effectless and less-potent sandstorm.

The purple streaks that have been radiated from the planet into orbit can be seen from the ground between the clouds both during daytime and nighttime and occasionally "blink", giving the surface a more purple color before dimming.

==== The Void ====
On Desert Cliffs planets encompassed by [[The Void]], not many changes to the geography can be seen. Notably, nights seem to be brighter than normal, with the skies being filled with puffy clouds and enough sand to color parts of the skies yellow/orange.

== Environmental Conditions ==
* Intense Heat does not occur at night.
{{Environmental Conditions|Intense Heat|Tremors}}

== Environmental Hazards ==
* Occasional misty springs, harmless, though they slow down any Helldivers deciding to take a bath
* Tall dead [[Fern]]s, slowing any creatures walking through down

== Weather ==
* Clear
** Clear weather features some fog created by dust, and skies which are usually half covered by clouds.
[[file:Desert Cliffs Weather Clear.png|frameless]]

* Sandrain
** Sandrain weather features thicker and more orange fog, droplets of sand falling from the skies, and a sky covered around 70-80% by clouds.
[[file:Ustotu Planet Landscape Header.png|frameless]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Sandy type [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]].

== Description ==
{{Quote|A blazing-hot desert planet, its rocky mesas are the sole interruptions to the endless sea of dunes.}}
The Desert Dunes biome is composed of sandy dune-based terrain, more often than not being flat, however, it still features occasional hills, and rarely a set of misty springs and ponds.

Small and medium-sized rocks and rock formations cover the surface, providing sudden cover. In between the rocks and the sand, sometimes tall, dead shrubs can be found.

The skies are blue similar to Earth, showcasing sand-colored clouds and one or more large suns. A massive approaching sandstorm can also be seen in the backdrop of the planet, though it will not disappear regardless of whether a sandstorm event occurs.

Thanks to the sandy surface of the planet, lots of structures and assets (including the Helldiver) will be covered by ''some'' sand.

=== Surface Variations ===
==== Metropolises ====
In parks located in [[Metropolis]]es, the usual sandy terrain can be found. Although the biome seemingly has no trees, trees usually seen in Primordial biomes ''(such as the [[Volcanic Jungle]])'' will generate, having green leaves in this biome.

==== Exostorms ====
On Desert Dunes planets that have been engulfed by an [[Exostorm]], all Environmental Conditions will be removed. A permanent, slightly less potent [[Sandstorms]] will engluf the surface, featuring dusty skies and thick "fog" which still feature reduced visibility.

The purple streaks that have been radiated from the planet into orbit can be seen from the ground between the clouds both during daytime and nighttime and occasionally "blink", giving the surface a more purple color before dimming.

== Environmental Conditions ==
Intense Heat is only active during the day, meanwhile Extreme Cold is only active at night.

{{Environmental Conditions|Intense Heat|Extreme Cold|Sandstorms}}

== Environmental Hazards ==
* Occasional misty springs, harmless, though they slow down any Helldivers deciding to take a bath
* Tall dead [[Fern]]s, slowing any creatures walking through down

== Weather ==
* Clear
** Clear weather is the standard weather for the Desert Dunes, featuring light distant fog and clouds that barely even cover the sky. The clouds can be either puffy or thin veil-like, though not both simultaneously.
[[file:Desert Dunes Weather Clear.png|frameless]]

* Hazy
** Hazy weather is a common weather effect in the Desert Dunes, with thicker fog setting in (though not enough to significantly lower visibility). Light wind and heat distortion effects also set in for the duration of the event.
[[file:Desert Dunes Weather Hazy.png|frameless]]

* Standstorm
** Sandstorms are rare weather events that cause a massive orange fog of lifted sand to suddenly appear around the mission area. Along with the fog and the sand particles rapidly flying in one direction, lightning is also present.
** They are rampant and sudden, with the visibility dropping to a radius of about 50 meters in less than 30 seconds.
[[file:Desert Dunes Weather Sandstorm.png|frameless]]

pages.Desert Oasis:
{{Infobox Biome | biome = Desert Oasis | landscape = Tropical Oasis Biome Header.png | caption_landscape = | description = No description given. | internal_name = oasis_base | archetype = Oasis | armor_camo = Desert }} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an Oasis [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in ''[[Helldivers 2]]''. == Description == The Desert Oasis is an arid biome featuring sandy dunes and some grassy patches. Aside from the grassy patches and the ferns found within them, large palm trees can also be seen growing out of the sand with tall trunks and dropping leaves. Large natural rocks can also be found everywhere, covered in sand. The surface also features knee-deep lakes of beautiful light blue water, also coming in the form of massive lakes and rivers that cross the mission area. The skies are usually blue, taking on a slightly darker tone at night which allows for good visibility. The skies are sometimes covered by white, puffy clouds and thin veil-like clouds. As for fauna, Avian, Amphibious, and Insectoid sounds can be heard, and at least one dragonfly-like creature can be seen floating and flying around. {{Infobox Biome
 | biome=Icy Glaciers
 | landscape=arctic_glacier_base_Landscape.png
 | caption_landscape=
 | description=Submerged in eternal winter, this world's frosty peaks glimmer in the light of its too-distant star.
