The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an Arctic type [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]].

== Description ==
{{Quote|Submerged in eternal winter, this world's frosty peaks glimmer in the light of its too-distant star.}}

Icy Glaciers is an arctic biome that features thick snow coverage and lots of ice. The surface is divided between two sections: rocky, and icy. The rocky surface is made up of hills, rocks and rocky mountains covered with snow. The icy surface is made up from the frozen waters of the planet, featuring glacial mountains, rocks, up-facing icicles, and slippery ice, which is all slightly covered by snow. Ravines can also rarely be spotted on the surface.

The thick snow on the surface slows Helldivers down slightly whenever they walk on it. The snow will also be pushed and crumpled down whenever anything walks or slides over it, allowing for the creation of "snow angels". Another feature exclusive to the Icy Glacier's snow is the formation of Snowballs, which will rarely form whenever looking down at the snow. They can be picked up and thrown, but deal no damage.

While due to the extremely low temperatures of the Icy Glaciers, most of the water has frozen over, some liquid water can also still be found on the surface. This water is deep enough to drown a careless Helldiver.

While natural fauna seems to be completely missing, some flora like the [[Frost Flower]] and small grass still manage to grow on the surface of these extremely cold planets. Dead, frozen ferns can also occasionally be seen.

Foreign objects such as {{Terminid|text}} biomatter, crates, and [[High-Value Pickup]]s are covered by a thin sheet of snow.

=== Surface Variations ===
==== Colonies ====
[[Colonies]] on Icy Glaciers planets feature asphalt streets covered by patches of snow, as well as a thin sheet of snow covering everything else from crates, to rooftops, to corpses.

==== Metropolises ====
In parks located in [[Metropolis]]es, the usual snowy terrain can be found. Although the biome seemingly has no trees, pine trees will still generate, along with Frost Flowers. Thin snow covers almost every surface, including cars, streets, and enemy installations.

==== Megafactories ====
In the exterior of [[Megafactory|Megafactories]], the snowy terrain will be almost completely flat, with small hills and dunes. External terrain also still features large ice rocks and ravines, but always lacks mountains, gigantic rocks, and water. Frost Flowers and ice spikes can still occasionally be found.

The same applies to the interior of Megafactories, with the exception of Frost Flowers and ice spikes generating. The interior also features a mix of dirt/gravel and snow for the terrain, and sometimes ice will appear in place of rocks for edges. As is the case for this biome, every surface is covered by a thin sheet of snow.

== Environmental Conditions ==
*{{Environmental Conditions|Blizzards|Extreme Cold}}
** Due to the cold conditions of the Icy Glaciers, a Helldiver's screen will visually freeze near the edges and corners. Armor and Capes will also visually freeze, though they're only cosmetic and do not cause any negative effects.

== Environmental Hazards ==
* [[Frost Flower]]s will explode into a mist that slows any Helldiver or Enemy inside if damaged.
* Slippery Ice reduces the friction of the ground, negatively impacting driving while on the ice.
* Water deep enough to drown a careless Helldiver.

== Weather ==
* Clear
** Clear weather is the base state of the Icy Glaciers. The skies are lightly covered by thin veil-like clouds, and features little fog. Light wind and light snowfall also occurs passively during clear weather..
[[File:Icy Glaciers Weather Clear.png|frameless]]

* Snowstorm
** The Snowstorm is a weather effect where heavy snowfall and wind begins to occur while fog quickly begins to set in, dropping the visibility dramatically.
** Snowstorms both negatively and positively affect Helldivers by decreasing walking and running speeds, while also significantly decreasing enemy detection range.
[[File:Icy Glaciers Weather Snowstorm.png|frameless]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a unique [[Automatons|Automaton]] exclusive [[biomes|biome]] that was introduced in update [[1.005.000]]. It is a fiery planet fully of lava and little vegetation.

== Description ==
{{Quote|Constant eruptions keep this planet covered in lava flows and utterly inhospitable to Democratic life. It also makes it a treasure trove of rare minerals.}}

Magma Desert planets are known for being extremely hot and inhospitable to most forms of organic life. Filled with lava and distant volcanoes, the thick ashen and extremely noxious atmosphere causes the surface to be encased with light fog, and fills the skies until sunlight can barely pass through. The underground is also filled with platinum, which the {{Automaton|text}} seems to be mining for.

The landscape is typically very rocky, filled with ridges, mountains, ravines and massive rocks. Even on the flatter areas there's lots of burning rocks to be found. The terrain also mostly consists of grey sand and rock, with occasional large basalt pillar formations being seen everywhere. Across the surface, crevices filled with flowing lava can also be found.

A lot of the surface also mainly consists of lava, coming in the form of lakes, rivers and even seas, as well as rarely small pockets found anywhere. On surfaces near lava, small to medium-sized lava geysers can also be found, spurting out lava violently every now and then. Near lava, the fog will gain a vibrant, orange/red glow.

As for life on the planet, some things seemingly thrive on the inhospitable surface, mainly patches of green-gray grass, sometimes tall enough to slow Helldivers walking through them, as well as rare grey cacti. As for fauna, none can be seen anywhere.

Rarely, Automaton-built bridges spanning small lakes and rivers of lava can be found, which can be used by both the Helldivers and the Automatons to cross them easily.

=== Colonies ===
While the Magma Desert is inhospitable to most forms of organic life, apparently human-built [[Colonies]] and their colonists seem to thrive on the planet, though their streets are seemingly charred. ''(The existence of Colonies could be unintentional as colonies were initially not present on Magma Deserts.)''

== Environmental Conditions ==
{{Environmental Conditions|Intense Heat}}

== Environmental Hazards ==
* [[Lava]] lakes, rivers, and pockets ignite anything flammable and deal extra damage when standing on it for prolonged periods of time.
* [[Lava Geyser]]s periodically explode, creating a shockwave that launches any Helldivers that stand too close into the air, before spurting out lava and igniting anything nearby for a few seconds.
* Grey Cacti which slowly drain your health when touched.
* Tall grass which slow any Helldivers passing through down.

== Weather ==
* Clear
* Overcast
* Windy

== Planets ==
{{#invoke:PlanetStats|GetPlanetsWithBiome|magma_base}}

== Trivia ==
* Magma Deserts are the first biome to be introduced with a new planet. While other biomes were introduced by changing existing planets' biomes, the first three Magma Planets were brand new, with their own locations and supply lines.
* Super Earth High Command found out that the Automatons were protecting themselves on Magma Planets by retrofitting themselves with  {{MajorOrderLink|id=A3-1-2|text= iridium-infused superalloy heatsinks}}. After defending the planets from Automaton counter-attack, they were later repurposed by [[Federation of Super Earth|Super Earth]] for the Star of Peace's maximum-density thermal dissipation housing.
** The surplus iridium was used to create premium amenities, such as iridium-plated latrines, novelty beverage goblets, and complimentary viewing glasses for children when the Star of Peace's inaugural operation.

pages.Metropolis:
{{DisambigMsg|the {{PAGENAME}} subbiome|the smaller, grid based structures found on standard missions|Colonies|the planet regions system|Regions}}
{{Infobox Biome
 | biome=Metropolis
 | landscape=Metropolis Landscape Header.png
 | caption_landscape=
 | internal_name = no_name
 | archetype = Megastructure
 | subvariant = Urban Megastructures
}}

'''Metropolises''' are a type of urban megastructure constructed by the {{Super Earth|text}}, unique to the [[Regions]] found on some planets.

== Overview ==
Metropolises encompass the entirety of the playable mission area when present, compared to the smaller [[Colonies]] that only occupy a portion of it.

Within a Metropolis, a web of roads form city blocks littered with skyscrapers and other large structures. These blocks may occasionally be of a lower density, providing space to parks, playgrounds, and smaller buildings. 

The Metropolis can inherit certain changes based on the planet's [[Biome]], such as color scheme and weather.

Parks and local flora appear differently based on the current planet's [[Biome]]. For instance, trees and grass are colored blue on an [[Ionic Jungle]] planet, and grass is replaced entirely with sandy soil on [[Desert Dunes|Desert Dune]] worlds. 

[[Environmental Conditions]] are carried over from the parent biome as well, such as [[Volcanic Activity]] or [[Intense Heat]].

Platoons of [[SEAF Soldier]]s spawn naturally throughout Metropolises.

Metropolises change drastically in appearance based on whether the current planet is under a '''Liberation''' or '''Defense Campaign''':
* On Defense campaigns, billboards, street signs, and light fixtures function properly. Structures remain largely unscathed prior to combat, and buildings outside the mission area are completely untouched. Roaming mobs of [[Civilian]]s may spawn throughout the city in addition to SEAF soldiers.
* On Liberation campaigns, the loss of electricity plunges cities into darkness. Buildings generate pre-destroyed, including those outside the mission area, and are often overtaken by the incumbent faction. SEAF soldiers can still appear, but roaming Civilians will never naturally spawn. Lower density blocks (parks, etc.) are also less likely to generate.

== Tactical Information ==
*Skyscrapers significantly hamper visibility from a bird's eye view, affecting a large amount of stratagems:
** Attacking [[Super Destroyer]]s may be forced to reposition in order to target the desired location, which may take multiple seconds to complete. 
** [[Eagle]] attack vectors may change direction in order to avoid buildings and target stratagem beacons.
** [[Pelican]]s delivering [[Exosuit]]s/[[FRV]]s may need to find a nearby open area to safely drop their cargo, instead of attempting to leave it directly beside the stratagem beacon.
** However, Stratagems delivered in Hellpods, such as [[Support Weapon]]s, [[Sentry|Sentries]], and [[Supplies]], are largely unaffected.
* Metropolises generally contain less useful points of interest than [[Colonies]], making it more difficult to obtain field-found ammunition and other supplies. 
* [[Bunker]]s can only spawn in lower density city blocks (i.e. parks), but often do so in groups. On the map, they take the appearance of a small square with the shape of an "L" on it.
** If specifically hunting for Bunkers, it is best to do so on planets under a '''Defense Campaign''', as lower density blocks are much less likely to spawn on '''Liberation Campaigns'''. 
* During the missions in metropolis, minor objectives may occasionally exhibit anomalies. These anomalous objectives do not appear during gameplay, even if the [[Radar Station]] side mission has been completed. They may appear during settling. 
** For example, during the settling of a Terminid mission, nonexistent [[SEAF SAM Site]] or the [[Retrieve Mutant Larva]] mission may appear.  
** Similarly, any [[SEAF Artillery]] objectives that did not spawn on the frontline may also be included.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Moor type [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]].

== Description ==
{{Quote|Rocky outcroppings punctuate fields of tall grass in a planet dominated by misty highland terrain.}}
The surface of Plains planets are full of green grass but unlike Earth, it features no natural trees. The surface is also very rocky, featuring pillars, boulders and large rock formations on it's surface.

Thanks to it's rocky surface, some areas will consist of highlands, featuring coastal cliffs that drop down into the ocean. However on non-highland areas, entire beaches and lakes can be found.

The skies which are naturally blue, are very cloudy as it commonly rains on the planet. With rain, visibility drops and occasionally fills the skies.

As for fauna, floating bio-luminescent Jellyfish can be found in the air.

=== Surface Variations ===
==== Metropolises ====
In parks located in [[Metropolis]]es, the usual grassy terrain can be found. Although the biome seemingly has no trees in any wilderness areas, Earth-like trees will generate with grey-brownish leaves in this biome.

Small rock formations can still be found in parks and grassy areas.

==== Exostorms ====
On Plains planets that harbor an [[Exostorm]], the usually grey/white light fog will turn a light shade of purple. The purple streaks that have been radiated from the planet into orbit can be seen from the ground between the clouds both during daytime and nighttime. It will also permanently drizzle instead of being subjected to the occasional [[Rainstorms]].

== Environmental Conditions ==
{{Environmental Conditions|Rainstorms}}

== Environmental Hazards ==
* [[Smoke Shroom|Smoke Shrooms]] will explode into a brown smoke if damaged.
* Deep pits of mud slow down Helldivers trying to move through.
* Tall Jagged Cliffs usually line the edges of the mission area and any Helldiver unlucky enough to fall off will instantly die.

== Weather ==
* Cloudy
** Cloudy is the base weather of the Plains biome, featuring large clouds that cover around 50% of the skies, as well as a very thick fog.
[[file:Achernar Secundus Planet Landscape Header.png|frameless]]

* Overcast
** Overcast weather features skies almost completely filled by clouds with small gaps for light to come in through. Unlike on cloudy weather, fog is barely present, only being slightly thicker than on most planets.
[[file:Reaf Planet Landscape Header.png|frameless]]

* Rainstorm
** Rainstorms weather features skies that are completely covered by clouds, as well as some fog. Rain and wind are also clearly present, though the planet also darkens slightly.
[[file:Plains Weather Rainstorm.png|frameless]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Sandy type [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]].

== Description ==
{{Quote|This arid, rocky biome covering this world has driven the evolution of exceptionally efficient water usage in its various organisms.}}
The Rocky Canyons biome is the [[Acidic Badlands]]' copper-colored brother. It's terrain is mostly rocky, sandy, and hill-based, but it also features flatter areas, and occasionally a set of misty springs. Most noticeable are the mega rock formations, being taller than most buildings. In between the rocks and the sand, sometimes tall, dead shrubs can be found.

At night, it may become extremely dark, so flashlight use is recommended.

=== Surface Variations ===
==== Metropolises ====
In parks located in [[Metropolis]]es, the usual red/bron sandy terrain can be found with small red flora occasionally growing out of it. Although the biome seemingly has no trees, trees usually seen in Primordial biomes ''(such as the [[Volcanic Jungle]])'' will generate, having green leaves and blue trunks in this biome.

Brown muddy terrain can rarely be found in park structures.

==== The Gloom ====
[[The Gloom]] changes the skies and fog into a much more noticeable yellow, the new color making the red sand appear darker and more vibrant. The night skies still feature the bright orange Gloom spores from space, reflecting light back down onto the planet itself and giving it a more green night color, as well as increasing brightness and visibility.

Unlike on other biomes, the tremors environmental effect is still present.

==== The Void ====
Unlike on other biomes, [[the Void]] doesn't significantly alter Rocky Canyons planets, with planets only featuring more wind and slightly increased fog. The tremors environmental effect is completely absent.

== Environmental Conditions ==
{{Environmental Conditions|Tremors}}

== Environmental Hazards ==
* Occasional misty springs, harmless, though they slow down any Helldivers deciding to take a bath.
* [[Fern|Slowing Ferns]] are often present near rock formations.

== Weather ==
* Overcast
** Overcast is the default weather for the Rocky Canyons, featuring skies almost completely covered by thick clouds, being either green or orange depending on the time of day. Light fog and wind can also be seen on the surface.
** While the clouds can occasionally clear slightly, the cloud coverage will never drop under 50%.
[[file:Rocky Canyons Weather Overcast.png|frameless]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Moor type [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]].

== Description ==
{{Quote|Scorching temperatures, high winds, and low precipitation cause a near-constant cycle of fires to sweep this planet, punctuated by short bursts of lush rebirth between infernos.}}

The surface of Scorched Moor planets are full of a scorched, dead brown grass. Trees can also be found, though they will not have any leaves present and will be charred and scorched. The surface is also very rocky and uneven, featuring pillars, boulders, large rock formations and massive sharp mountains on it's surface. Though in some parts of the biome, the surface can become relatively flat.

Most prominently, the biome is extremely hot as [[Fire Tornados]] scour the surface every now and then. Due to this, water is also seemingly non-existent on the planet unless generated within a structure (for example, an area converted by the [[Terminids]]).

The skies are relatively clear, featuring thin clouds. Though once Fire Tornados begin appearing, the clouds can become a glowing fiery orange, and fog will thicken slightly.

Some of the planets also feature a massive ringed gas giant/brown dwarf planet nearby, which lights up the sky at night and causes common eclipses during the day.

==== Metropolises ====
[[Metropolis]]es within a Scorched Moor generate green earthly terrain with the biome's usual brown grass blades. Earth-like trees with normal green leaves will also be found in certain parks alongside green ferns and plants with pink flowers.

==== The Gloom ====
When inside [[The Gloom]], the planet loses it's main environmental condition [[Fire Tornados]]. The atmosphere and the clouds become noticeably more yellow than usual as a yellow/orange fog permanently appears in the distance. The brown grass also becomes much more defined, with a hint of orange being added.

Oddly enough when inside The Gloom, the skies gain large, puffy yellow clouds that aren't present on non-Gloom planets under normal weather conditions.

== Environmental Conditions ==
Temperature in this biome is variable. Whenever [[Fire Tornados]] are active, [[Intense Heat]] will also be active.

{{Environmental Conditions|Intense Heat|Fire Tornados}}

== Environmental Hazards ==
* [[Smoke Shroom|Smoke Shrooms]] will explode into a brown smoke if damaged.
* Deep pits of mud slow down Helldivers trying to move through.

== Weather ==
* Clear
** Mostly clear skies. Rarely features small, thin clouds.
[[File:Scorched Moor Sky Clear.png|frameless]]

* Fire Tornados
** The surface is covered by thick, orange fog as fire sparks float around. Large fiery vortexes descend to the surface as they roam around and set everything ablaze. The skies gain a puffy cloud layer that covers most of the sky along with an orange fiery shin just above the clouds. '''(image 1)'''
*** During sunrise or sunset, the puffy clouds receive an orange tint and become completely visible. '''(image 2)'''
** The weather also fluctuates between the start and the end, beginning with the tornadoes and the fog appearing, as well as the cloud layer slowly setting in. Then once the cloud layer is fully present, the orange tint above the clouds begins to set in. Once the weather condition nears it's end, the clouds and the fog disappear while the tornados and the fiery layer stay, before disappearing shortly after as well.
[[File:Scorched Moor Sky Fire Tornadoes.png|frameless]][[File:Scorched Moor Sky Fire Tornadoes Orange.png|frameless]]

And the utopian future awaiting the entire galaxy. | internal_name = | archetype = Special }} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a unique [[Biomes|biome]] found exclusively on [[Super Earth]]. == Description == {{Quote|The blinding beacon that illuminates the stars with the light of Democracy. The patriotic paradise for citizens who truly serve their Federation. And the utopian future awaiting the entire galaxy.}} This biome consists of familiar green grass, oak trees, and similar vegetation. No native fauna can be found in this biome. Stars cannot be seen in this biome's skyline, implying extreme light pollution. Super Earth only offers operations in [[Metropolis]] regions, and shares many of its attributes as a result. Like other cities, Super Earth cities feature giant skyscrapers and buildings, large parks and playgrounds (which can hide [[Take Down Overship|Planetary Defense Cannons]]), and are connected with large networks of roads in polygonal patterns. These roadways are distinct from the [[Colonies]] seen on colony worlds, as they are not all grid-based. === Atmosphere === The sky is clear during daytime, and the night is dark blue with almost no illumination coming from the sky when the Moon isn't up. The clouds are slow-moving and puffy, sometimes covering the majority, if not the whole sky. During sundown and sunrise, the sky lights up in a deep orange glow, enlightening buildings and clouds alike in a golden embrace. When rainstorms or light rain take place, the sky above turns into a light grey alongside fog of a similar color. The biome's surface mostly consists of Terminid matter, creating shores, hills, and rocks. Across the surface, massive Terminid spires stand, made up of the same Terminid matter. The surface is also filled with yellow puddles and small rivers everywhere. pages.Tundra:
{{Infobox Biome | biome=Tundra | landscape=moor_tundra_Landscape.png | caption_landscape= | description=A perenially chilly climate has allowed short, colorful shrubs to flourish across this planet's surface. | internal_name = moor_tundra | archetype = Moor | armor_camo = Forest }} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Moor type [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]]. == Description == {{Quote|A perennially chilly climate has allowed short, colorful shrubs to flourish across this planet's surface.}} The surface of Tundra planets are filled by orange grass, flowers, bushes, and pine trees. The surface is also very rocky, featuring pillars, boulders and large rock formations on it's surface. Thanks to it's rocky surface, some areas will consist of highlands, featuring coastal cliffs that drop down into the ocean. However on non-highland areas, entire beaches and lakes can be found. Clouds can be seen filling the blue skies as they cause light, yet permanent drizzling. At night, green aurora borealis will fill the skies, providing some green light onto the surface. Floating around are also blades of grass and leaves that have broken off from their respective plants. For fauna, occasional dragonflies and butterflies can be seen flying around. === Surface Variations === ==== Metropolises ==== In parks located in [[Metropolis]]es, green grassy terrain can be found growing with orange grass blades. Although the biome has pine trees present in wilderness areas, Earth-like trees will generate with green leaves in this biome while any pine trees will be missing. == Environmental Conditions == This biome has no environmental conditions. == Environmental Hazards == * [[Smoke Shroom]]s will explode into a brown smoke if damaged. * Deep pits of mud slow down Helldivers trying to move through. * Tall Jagged Cliffs usually line the edges of the mission area and any Helldiver unlucky enough to fall off will instantly die. * Water can also be a threat for any Helldiver deciding to take a swim. == Weather == * Cloudy ** Cloudy weather is the base weather of the Tundra, featuring light fog, blue skies, and puffy clouds that cover about 50% of the skies. Occasionally, thin veil-like clouds can also be seen covering the skies. * Sunshower ** Sunshowers are a common weather effect of the Tundra, though not much changes visually other than the appearance of some light drizzling and wet spots on a Helldiver's screen. ** So little changes between the normal Cloudy weather and Sunshowers that if it weren't for the raindrops on a Helldiver's screen, the weather effect would go completely unnoticed. The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Primordial type [[biomes|biome]] that can be found on various planets in [[Helldivers 2]].

== Description ==
{{Quote|Abundant with life, this wet planet is covered in deep oceans, thick forests, and tall grasses.}}
These planet types are known for their lush, dense, humid jungles filled with life. High above the jungles and active volcanoes, flocks of four winged birds can be seen flying across the sky. The Volcanic Jungle is the green colored triplet of the [[Ionic Jungle]] and the [[Ethereal Jungle]] primordial biomes.

Like the other primordial biomes, the Volcanic Jungle features dense and humid jungles full of trees, plants and ferns, all of them having green leaves. Large, lush clearings also fill the surface, full of green grass, flowers and rock formations. The planet also features beaches, oceans, the occasional lake, distant mountain ranges and volcanoes.

The biome is very tropical, as if someone had made an entire planet look like the coastlines of the Cabiric. The Volcanic Jungle is one of the four biomes that resemble Earth the most, right behind the [[Deciduous Forest]] and the [[Plains]] biomes.

These green jungles are filled with life, and feature at least one four-winged Avian creature that flies in flocks above the surface.

=== Surface Variations ===
==== Atmosphere ====
Depending on various factors, the overall color of the planet's atmosphere may also change. This may be seen when selecting the planet on the galactic map, where the glowing outline of planet's hologram turns into it's atmosphere's respective color.

* '''Blue/Earth-like:''' Planets like [[Regnus]] and [[Meissa]] have normal blue-colored atmospheres during the day, becoming dark blue at night. As a hologram on the Galactic Map, they have a blue hue.
* '''Yellow:''' Planets like [[Gaellivare]] and [[Irulta]] have yellow-colored atmospheres that have a very noticeable yellow/orange hue during the day, becoming a normal dark blue at night. As a hologram on the Galactic Map, they have a barely noticeable yellow hue.

==== Metropolises ====
In parks located in [[Metropolis]]es, the usual green grassy terrain will be present. While the planet has primordial trees, green Earth-like trees will generate instead.

== Environmental Conditions ==
{{Environmental Conditions|Rainstorms}}{{Environmental Conditions|Volcanic Activity}} 

== Environmental Hazards ==
* [[Spike Plant]]s that will explode into tiny pieces much like the [[G-6 Frag]] grenade, if it takes any damage.
* [[Lava Pits]] will kill any Helldiver unlucky enough to fall inside.
* Slowing ferns can also commonly be found across the surface, especially near rock formations and in denser jungles.

== Weather ==
* Clear
** Clear weather is the base state of the Volcanic Jungle biome, with puffy, but mostly transparent clouds covering little of the sky at all times. Fog is minimal and distant.
[[File:Volcanic Jungle Weather Clear.png|frameless]]

* Cloudy
** Cloudy weather only occurs before or after a Rainstorm as they are the precursor to it. The skies will quickly fill with dark grey clouds and fog will quickly appear and intensify.
[[File:Volcanic Jungle Weather Cloudy.png|frameless]]

* Rainstorm
** Following the cloudy weather, Rainstorms have fully covered skies with little to no sky visible, and fog is still rampant and cause lower-than-usual visibility. This weather effect begins after the cloudy effect with drizzling, before intensifying into a heavy rainstorm for a few minutes, before drizzling once more and finally returning to clear weather.
[[File:Volcanic Jungle Weather Rainstorm.png|frameless]]
